--stuff for the first letter, kick or a punching combo prefix if matches[2] == "w" then comboPartOne = "wwk" elseif matches[2] == "a" then comboPartOne = "mnk left" elseif matches[2] == "s" then comboPartOne = "sdk" elseif matches[2] == "d" then comboPartOne = "mnk right" elseif matches[2] == "z" then comboPartOne = "snk left" elseif matches[2] == "x" then comboPartOne = "snk right" elseif matches[2] == "j" then comboPartOne = "jpk" elseif matches[2] == "q" then comboPartOne = "axk" elseif matches[2] == "f" then comboPartOne = "swk" elseif matches[2] == "r" then comboPartOne = "rhk" end
if matches[3] == "w" then comboPartTwo = "ucp" elseif matches[3] == "a" then comboPartTwo = "spp left" elseif matches[3] == "s" then comboPartTwo = "hkp" elseif matches[3] == "d" then comboPartTwo = "spp right" elseif matches[3] == "z" then comboPartTwo = "hfp left" elseif matches[3] == "x" then comboPartTwo = "hfp right" elseif matches[3] == "f" then comboPartTwo = "jbp arms" elseif matches[3] == "e" then comboPartTwo = "jbp head" elseif matches[3] == "q" then comboPartTwo = "pmp" end
if matches[4] == "w" then comboPartThree = "ucp" elseif matches[4] == "a" then comboPartThree = "spp left" elseif matches[4] == "s" then comboPartThree = "hkp" elseif matches[4] == "d" then comboPartThree = "spp right" elseif matches[4] == "z" then comboPartThree = "hfp left" elseif matches[4] == "x" then comboPartThree = "hfp right" elseif matches[4] == "f" then comboPartThree = "jbp arms" elseif matches[4] == "e" then comboPartThree = "jbp head" elseif matches[4] == "q" then comboPartThree = "pmp" end
send("cq all|queue add eqbal combo " .. target .. " " .. comboPartOne .. " " .. comboPartTwo .. " " .. comboPartThree) comboPartOne = nil comboPartTwo = nil comboPartThree = nil

Alias.name: Group damage
Alias.script:
-- ^shdam$: embedded implementation; no runtime file loading. local revision = 'dac6055270daee634e055dc8de424a0c79a6e3919e36252430ce47bc8b9b4c93' local installed = Yso and Yso.off and Yso.off.monk and Yso.off.monk.group_damage if not installed or installed._source_revision ~= revision then (function() -- Embedded in ^shdam$ at build time. Uses the package route-loop controller. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.off = Yso.off or {} Yso.off.monk = Yso.off.monk or {} local M = Yso.off.monk.group_damage or {} Yso.off.monk.group_damage = M M.key = 'monk_shikudo_group_damage' M.name = 'Shikudo group damage' M.alias_owned = true M.cfg = M.cfg or {leg='left', loop_delay=0.15, confirmation_timeout=10} M.state = M.state or {}
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') end local function now() local value = type(getEpoch)=='function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() if value > 20000000000 then value=value/1000 end return value end local function echo_status(text) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cyan>[SHIKUDO] <reset>'..text..'\n') end end local function form_tracker() return Yso.monk and Yso.monk.shikudo end local function current_target() if type(Yso.get_target)=='function' then return trim(Yso.get_target()) end return trim(rawget(_G,'target')) end local function monk() local class = Yso.classinfo and type(Yso.classinfo.get)=='function' and Yso.classinfo.get() local status = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status class = class or (status and (status.class or status.classname)) or Yso.class return trim(class):lower()=='monk' end local function ready_value(value) return value==true or tostring(value)=='1' end local function eq_ready() local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local eq=v.eq if eq==nil then eq=v.equilibrium end if not ready_value(eq) then return false end if Yso.state and type(Yso.state.eq_ready)=='function' and not Yso.state.eq_ready() then return false end if Yso.locks and type(Yso.locks.eq_ready)=='function' and not Yso.locks.eq_ready() then return false end return true end local function ready() local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local bal=v.bal if bal==nil then bal=v.balance end if not ready_value(bal) or not eq_ready() then return false end if Yso.state and type(Yso.state.bal_ready)=='function' and not Yso.state.bal_ready() then return false end if Yso.locks and type(Yso.locks.bal_ready)=='function' and not Yso.locks.bal_ready() then return false end return true end local function mindlock() return Yso.monk and Yso.monk.mindlock end local function mental_kind(kind) return kind=='mindlock' or kind=='mind_crush' or kind=='kai_choke' end
-- Room presence is melee reach, not proof of mental reach or line of sight. function M.note_room_players() local list=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players if type(list)~='table' then return end M.state.room_players={} M.state.room_snapshot_invalid=false for _,entry in pairs(list) do local name=type(entry)=='table' and entry.name or entry if type(name)=='string' then M.state.room_players[trim(name):lower()]=true end end if M.state.room_players[current_target():lower()] then M.state.melee_missing=nil end end function M.target_in_room(tgt) tgt=trim(tgt):lower() if M.state.melee_missing==tgt then return false end if M.state.room_snapshot_invalid then return nil end if type(M.state.room_players)=='table' and M.state.room_players[tgt]~=nil then return M.state.room_players[tgt]==true end local players=Legacy and Legacy.Room and Legacy.Room.players if type(players)=='table' then for name,present in pairs(players) do if trim(name):lower()==tgt then return present==true end end return nil end return nil end function M.note_local_target_activity(name) name=trim(name):lower() if name~=current_target():lower() then return false end M.state.room_players=M.state.room_players or {};M.state.room_players[name]=true M.state.melee_missing=nil;M.state.room_snapshot_invalid=false;return true end local function has_aff(tgt, aff) -- AK's current-target predicate prevents old target scores being reused. if type(IsTargetted)~='function' or not IsTargetted(tgt) then return false end if Yso.ak and type(Yso.ak.has)=='function' then return Yso.ak.has(aff)==true end return false end
function M.init() M.state.loop_delay=tonumber(M.cfg.loop_delay) or 0.15 M.state.template=M.state.template or {} if not M.state.room_initialized then if not M.state.room_snapshot_invalid then M.note_room_players() end M.state.room_initialized=true end if not M.status_alias and type(tempAlias)=='function' then M.status_alias=tempAlias('^shstatus$',function() local s=M.status() echo_status('Status: '..(s.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')..', target='..s.target ..', form='..s.form..', kata='..tostring(s.kata)..', BAL='..tostring(s.bal) ..', EQ='..tostring(s.eq)..', execute='..s.dispatch_reason ..', mindlock='..s.mindlock..', reach='..s.reach ..', hold='..tostring(s.hold_reason or 'none')..'.') end) end return true end function M.is_enabled() return M.state.enabled==true end function M.is_active() return monk() and Yso.mode and Yso.mode.is_combat() and M.state.loop_enabled==true end
-- Shared AI and combo validation are also available to future Shikudo routes. function M.select(ctx) local F = form_tracker() local A = F and F.ai local C = Yso.monk and Yso.monk.combo if not A or type(A.select) ~= 'function' then return nil,'no_ai' end if not C or type(C.build_shikudo) ~= 'function' then return nil,'no_combo_builder' end if not trim(ctx.target):match("^[%a%d_'-]+$") then return nil,'invalid_target' end ctx.leg = M.cfg.leg local opts, why = A.select(ctx) if not opts then return nil,why end if opts.command then return opts.command,opts.kind end local cmd, reason = C.build_shikudo(ctx.target,opts) return cmd,cmd and opts.kind or reason end function M.note_recovery(limb) local p=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if not p then return end p.recovered[trim(limb):lower()]=true end function M.note_full_recovery() local p=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if p then p.full_recovery=true end end function M.note_eq_recovery() local p=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if p and mental_kind(p.kind) then p.eq_recovered=true end end function M.note_vitals() local p=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if not p then return end local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local bal=v.bal if bal==nil then bal=v.balance end if bal~=nil and not ready_value(bal) then p.saw_down=true end if p.saw_down and ready_value(bal) then p.full_recovery=true end local eq=v.eq if eq==nil then eq=v.equilibrium end if eq~=nil and not ready_value(eq) then p.saw_eq_down=true end if p.saw_eq_down and ready_value(eq) then p.eq_recovered=true end end -- Clear the decision on stop, but physical recovery survives rapid off/on. function M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() M.state.pending=nil; return true end local function pending_blocks() local p=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if not p then return false end -- Also observe snapshots when a caller ticks between GMCP handler callbacks. M.note_vitals() local F=form_tracker() local L=mindlock() local confirmed=M.state.pending==nil or p.kind=='combo' or p.kind=='dispatch' or p.kind=='mind_crush' or p.kind=='kai_choke' or (p.kind=='mindlock' and ((L and L.is_locked(p.target)) or trim(p.target):lower()~=current_target():lower())) or (not mental_kind(p.kind) and F and F.form and F.form~=p.form) -- Adoption spends general balance, not the three attack limb balances. -- Adoption needs confirmed full balance recovery; a stale ready snapshot -- cannot release its cooldown after a rapid off/on. Transitions are instant. local recovered=p.kind=='transition' or p.full_recovery or (p.kind=='combo' and p.recovered['left arm'] and p.recovered['right arm'] and p.recovered.legs) local lane_ready=ready() if mental_kind(p.kind) then recovered=p.eq_recovered; lane_ready=eq_ready() end if p.kind=='mindlock' then -- Locking is a confirmation handshake, not a fabricated BAL/EQ spend. confirmed=(L and L.is_locked(p.target)==true) or trim(p.target):lower()~=current_target():lower() recovered=confirmed end if confirmed and recovered and lane_ready then M.state.pending=nil; M.state.cooldown=nil; return false end if now()-p.at>=(tonumber(M.cfg.confirmation_timeout) or 10) then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'confirmation_timeout',false) end return true end
-- Read-only snapshot: querying status never releases pending work or stops a loop. function M.status() local F=form_tracker() local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local bal,eq=v.bal,v.eq if bal==nil then bal=v.balance end if eq==nil then eq=v.equilibrium end if bal==nil then bal='missing' end if eq==nil then eq='missing' end local tgt=current_target() local L=mindlock() local locked=L and type(L.is_locked)=='function' and L.is_locked(tgt)==true local in_room=M.target_in_room(tgt) local E=F and F.execute local eligible,reason=false,'no_execute_helper' if E and type(E.can_dispatch)=='function' then eligible,reason=E.can_dispatch(tgt) end local hold if not M.is_enabled() then hold='disabled' elseif not M.is_active() then hold='inactive' elseif type(Yso.offense_paused)=='function' and Yso.offense_paused() then hold='paused' elseif M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown then hold='awaiting_recovery' elseif not ((not locked or in_room==false) and eq_ready() or ready()) then hold='balance_down' elseif tgt=='' then hold='no_target' else hold=M.state.hold_reason end return {enabled=M.is_enabled(),target=tgt,form=tostring(F and F.form or 'none'), kata=tonumber(F and F.kata) or 0,bal=bal,eq=eq,dispatch_ready=eligible, dispatch_reason=reason,hold_reason=hold,mindlock=locked and 'locked' or 'unlocked', reach=in_room==true and 'melee' or (in_room==false and 'ranged_fallback' or 'unknown')} end
function M.can_run() M.init() if not M.is_enabled() then return false,'disabled' end if not M.is_active() then return false,'inactive' end if type(Yso.offense_paused)=='function' and Yso.offense_paused() then return false,'paused' end if pending_blocks() then return false,'awaiting_recovery' end local tgt=current_target() if tgt=='' then return false,'no_target' end if not tgt:match('^[%a%d_\'-]+$') then return false,'invalid_target' end local L=mindlock() if not L or type(L.is_locked)~='function' then return false,'no_mindlock_tracker' end local in_room=M.target_in_room(tgt) if in_room~=false and type(Yso.target_is_valid)=='function' and not Yso.target_is_valid(tgt) then return false,'invalid_target' end if not L.is_locked(tgt) or in_room==false then if not eq_ready() then return false,'equilibrium_down' end else if not ready() then return false,'balance_down' end if not (Yso.shield and type(Yso.shield.up)=='function') then return false,'no_shield_tracker' end end return true,tgt,in_room end
local function emit_action(cmd,kind,tgt,lane,form) if type(Yso.emit)~='function' then return false,'no_emitter' end if Yso.queue then return false,'legacy_queue_present' end local payload={target=tgt,route=M.key} payload[lane]=cmd if Yso.emit(payload,{kind='offense',reason=M.key,route=M.key,target=tgt,commit=true})~=true then return false,'emit_failed' end M.state.pending={at=now(),target=tgt,form=form,kind=kind,recovered={}} M.state.cooldown=M.state.pending M.state.last_cmd=cmd M.state.template.last_reason=kind return true,cmd end
-- Generic target errors are meaningful only during a recent route request. function M.note_target_unavailable() local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_active() or not p or trim(p.target):lower()~=current_target():lower() then return false end if now()-p.at>(tonumber(M.cfg.target_response_window) or 2) then return false end if p.kind=='combo' or p.kind=='dispatch' then M.note_vitals() M.state.melee_missing=current_target():lower() M.state.pending=nil if not p.saw_down then M.state.cooldown=nil end M.state.template.last_reason='physical_target_unavailable' if Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop then Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop(M.key,'physical_target_unavailable') end return true elseif mental_kind(p.kind) then M.note_vitals() if not p.saw_eq_down then M.state.cooldown=nil end Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'mental_target_unavailable',false) return true end return false end
function M.attack_function() local ok,tgt,in_room=M.can_run() if not ok then M.state.template.last_reason=tgt if M.state.hold_reason~=tgt then M.state.hold_reason=tgt; M.state.hold_since=now() end if M.state.loop_enabled and now()-M.state.hold_since>=5 and M.state.reported_hold~=tgt then M.state.reported_hold=tgt local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} echo_status('Holding: '..tostring(tgt)..' (target='..current_target() ..', form='..tostring(form_tracker() and form_tracker().form or 'none') ..', BAL='..tostring(v.bal or v.balance or 'missing') ..', EQ='..tostring(v.eq or v.equilibrium or 'missing')..').') end return false,tgt end M.state.hold_reason=nil -- Opening offense: one request, then wait for confirmed lock and EQ recovery. if not mindlock().is_locked(tgt) then return emit_action('mind lock '..tgt,'mindlock',tgt,'eq') end
local cmd,kind if in_room==false then -- Ranged fallback only; normal physical damage retains priority in room. local kai = type(Hadoken)=='function' and Hadoken() or rawget(_G,'hadoken') if (tonumber(kai) or 0)>=10 then cmd,kind='kai choke '..tgt,'kai_choke' else cmd,kind='mind crush '..tgt,'mind_crush' end return emit_action(cmd,kind,tgt,'eq') end local F=form_tracker() if not F or type(F.staff_command)~='function' then return false,'no_form_tracker' end -- Text confirmations update F.form immediately; don't reapply stale GMCP here. local form=F.form -- AK tracks leg breaks as leftleg/rightleg, not invented injury names. local injury=has_aff(tgt,M.cfg.leg=='right' and 'rightleg' or 'leftleg') local ctx={target=tgt,form=form,kata=F.kata,prone=has_aff(tgt,'prone'),leg_ready=injury, affs={paralysis=has_aff(tgt,'paralysis'),anorexia=has_aff(tgt,'anorexia'),stuttering=has_aff(tgt,'stuttering')}} -- 1. Shield check and shield handling. ctx.shield=Yso.shield.up(tgt)==true if ctx.shield then cmd,kind=M.select(ctx) if not cmd then return false,kind end end -- 2. Execute scripts, after the shield branch. if not ctx.shield then local E=F.execute if not E or type(E.can_dispatch)~='function' then return false,'no_execute_helper' end if E.can_dispatch(tgt)==true then cmd,kind='dispatch '..tgt,'dispatch' end end -- 3. Normal damage and form progression. if not cmd then cmd,kind=M.select(ctx) end if not cmd then return false,kind end local wield=F.staff_command() if not wield then return false,'no_staff' end local sent,detail=emit_action(wield..'&&'..cmd,kind,tgt,'bal',form) if sent then M.state.last_cmd=cmd end return sent,sent and cmd or detail end M.alias_loop_stop_details={inactive=true,disabled=true,invalid_target=true,no_mindlock_tracker=true,no_shield_tracker=true,no_form_tracker=true,no_execute_helper=true,no_staff=true,no_emitter=true,legacy_queue_present=true,unknown_form=true} function M.alias_loop_on_started() M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() -- A watchdog stop requires an explicit restart. Drop its expired decision -- then; can_run still requires current BAL/EQ readiness before any retry. -- Ordinary rapid off/on retains physical recovery protection. if M.state.retry_after_timeout then M.state.cooldown=nil M.state.retry_after_timeout=nil end M.state.hold_reason=nil; M.state.reported_hold=nil M.state.melee_missing=nil echo_status('Group damage ON. Use shdam again to stop.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() if ctx and ctx.reason=='confirmation_timeout' then M.state.retry_after_timeout=true end if not ctx or not ctx.silent then echo_status('Group damage OFF ('..tostring(ctx and ctx.reason or 'manual')..').') end end function M.alias_loop_on_error(err) echo_status('Group damage error: '..tostring(err)) Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'error',true) end function M.note_slain(name) if trim(name):lower()==current_target():lower() then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'target_slain',false) end end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then M.handlers=M.handlers or {} local callbacks={ ['gmcp.Char.Vitals']=M.note_vitals, ['gmcp.Room.Players']=function() M.note_room_players(); Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop(M.key,'room_players') end, ['gmcp.Room.AddPlayer']=function() local entry=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.AddPlayer local name=type(entry)=='table' and entry.name or entry if type(name)=='string' then M.state.room_players=M.state.room_players or {} M.state.room_players[trim(name):lower()]=true if trim(name):lower()==current_target():lower() then M.state.melee_missing=nil end end Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop(M.key,'room_add_player') end, ['gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer']=function() local entry=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer local name=type(entry)=='table' and entry.name or entry if type(name)=='string' and M.state.room_players then M.state.room_players[trim(name):lower()]=false if trim(name):lower()==current_target():lower() then M.state.melee_missing=trim(name):lower() end end Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop(M.key,'room_remove_player') end, ['gmcp.Room.Info']=function() M.state.room_players=nil; M.state.room_snapshot_invalid=true; M.state.melee_missing=nil end, sysDisconnectionEvent=function() Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'disconnect',true) M.state.cooldown=nil M.state.room_players=nil; M.state.room_initialized=nil M.state.room_snapshot_invalid=true end, } for event,fn in pairs(callbacks) do if M.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.handlers[event]) end M.handlers[event]=registerAnonymousEventHandler(event,fn) end end M.init() return M end)() Yso.off.monk.group_damage._source_revision = revision end if not (Yso and Yso.util and type(Yso.util.toggle_route_alias)=='function') then if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Route controller unavailable; check package load order.<reset>\n') end return end local ok, why = Yso.util.toggle_route_alias('monk_shikudo_group_damage', 'alias:shdam') if ok ~= true and type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Toggle failed: '..tostring(why or 'unknown')..'<reset>\n') end

Alias.name: Shikudo duel
Alias.script: if Yso and Yso.off and Yso.off.monk and Yso.off.monk.duel then Yso.off.monk.duel.alias(matches[2] or "") end

Alias.script: -- Superseded by Custom Shikudo pk combos. Keep disabled to prevent duplicate sends.

Alias.name: Shunt
Alias.script: local F = Yso and Yso.monk and Yso.monk.shikudo local bash = F and F.bash or shikudoBashing if type(bash) ~= 'function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Load the Bashing script in Yso Scripts > Core scripts > Monk Class > Shikudo.<reset>\n') return end bash()

Alias.name: Soaring
Alias.script: -- ^soa([lhs])$: send the full game command rather than a client alias. local elevations = { l = "low", h = "high", s = "stratosphere", } local elevation = elevations[matches[2]] if elevation then sendAll("clearqueue all", "aero soar " .. elevation) end

Alias.name: Demon strip
Alias.script: local char = gmcp and gmcp.Char or {} local class = char.Status and char.Status.class if not class or class == "" then class = char.Vitals and char.Vitals.class end if not class or class == "" then class = Yso and Yso.class end if tostring(class or ""):lower() == "apostate" then Yso.apostate.alias("strip") end

Alias.name: Horrify(fear denizen)
Alias.script:
-- Read entries such as "Rage: 35" from GMCP. local status = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status local class = tostring(status and status.class or ""):lower()
if class ~= "apostate" then cecho("\n<yellow>Horrify requires Apostate class.\n") return end local stats = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats
local rage
for _, stat in ipairs(stats or {}) do local value = tostring(stat):match("^%s*Rage:%s*(%d+)") if value then rage = tonumber(value) break end end
if not rage then cecho("\n<red>Horrify: rage data unavailable.\n") return end
if rage < 29 then cecho("\n<yellow>Horrify needs 29 rage. Current: " .. rage .. ".\n") return end
-- Hunting uses the server target; the combat target can still name a player. local serverTarget = gmcp and gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target local victim = tostring(serverTarget and serverTarget.Set or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if victim == "" then victim = tostring(target or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
if victim == "" then cecho("\n<red>Horrify: set a target first.\n") return end
send("stare " .. victim .. " horrify")

Script.name: Api stuff
Script.script:
-- Auto-exported from Mudlet package script: Api stuff -- DO NOT EDIT IN XML; edit this file instead.
--======================== -- Namespace normalization (Yso/yso bridge) -- Ensures BOTH _G.Yso and _G.yso exist and point to the same root table. --======================== do local root = rawget(_G, "Yso") if type(root) ~= "table" then root = rawget(_G, "yso") end if type(root) ~= "table" then root = {} end _G.Yso = root _G.yso = root Yso = root yso = root end
--========================================================-- -- Yso / Achaea Curing Core (Skeleton) -- • No snd() usage, Achaea-only. -- • Assumes: Legacy handles serverside CURING PRIORITY, etc. -- • Assumes: AK1 + AK Tracker track ENEMY afflictions only. -- • This file just defines the Yso.curing API and debug/status. --========================================================-- if type(setConsoleBufferSize) == "function" then setConsoleBufferSize("main", 300000, 1000) end
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.affs = Yso.affs or {} -- our own afflictions (you can wire GMCP/text later) Yso.curing = Yso.curing or {} Yso.ak = Yso.ak or {} -- forward declare so we can reference later if needed Yso.cfg = Yso.cfg or {}
-- Boot defaults: dry-run must be OFF unless explicitly enabled each session. Yso.net = Yso.net or {} Yso.net.cfg = Yso.net.cfg or {} if type(Yso.net.cfg.dry_run) ~= "boolean" then Yso.net.cfg.dry_run = false end -- Default command separator (Achaea CONFIG SEPARATOR) for all payload pipelines. -- User preference: "&&" (override by setting Yso.cfg.pipe_sep before load). Yso.cfg.pipe_sep = Yso.cfg.pipe_sep or "&&" Yso.cfg.cmd_sep = Yso.cfg.cmd_sep or Yso.cfg.pipe_sep Yso.cfg.route_gate_live = (Yso.cfg.route_gate_live == true) Yso.sep = Yso.sep or Yso.cfg.pipe_sep -- used for multi-command sends
-- ----------------- tiny helpers (shared) ----------------- Yso.util = Yso.util or {}
function Yso.util.now() local v = (type(getEpoch)=="function" and tonumber(getEpoch())) or nil if v then if v > 1e12 then v = v / 1000 end return v end return os.time() end
Yso.util.aff_aliases = Yso.util.aff_aliases or { prefarar = "sensitivity", }
function Yso.util.normalize_aff_name(name) name = tostring(name or ""):lower() if name == "" then return "" end local aliases = Yso.util.aff_aliases or {} return tostring(aliases[name] or name) end

if not text:match("\n$") then text = text .. "\n" end cecho(prefix .. text) end

-- ----------------- class tracking / segregation ----------------- Yso.classinfo = Yso.classinfo or {} do local C = Yso.classinfo

Yso.is_magi = Yso.is_magi or function() return C.is_magi() end Yso.is_alchemist = Yso.is_alchemist or function() return C.is_alchemist() end

C.get() end
-- Single-tick scheduler guard (shared key across disk/mpackage) Yso.util._tick_once_last = Yso.util._tick_once_last or {} function Yso.util.tick_once(key, min_dt, fn, ...) key = tostring(key or "") if key == "" or type(fn) ~= "function" then return false, "badargs" end min_dt = tonumber(min_dt) or 0 local now = Yso.util.now() local last = tonumber(Yso.util._tick_once_last[key] or 0) or 0 if min_dt > 0 and (now - last) < min_dt then return false, "throttled" end Yso.util._tick_once_last[key] = now local ok, res = pcall(fn, ...) if not ok then Yso.util.echo("tick_once ERR: "..tostring(res), "<red>") return false, res end return true, res end
-- ----------------- minimal locks (pending/backoff/cooldown hints) ----------------- -- NOTE: This is SSOT for lane readiness stability under GMCP lag. local function _now() return (Yso.util and Yso.util.now and Yso.util.now()) or os.time() end
function L.note_send(lane, pending) lane = tostring(lane or ""):lower() if lane == "ent" or lane == "entity" then lane = "class" end local st = L._lane[lane]; if not st then return end pending = tonumber(pending) or tonumber(L.cfg.pending) or 0.35 st.pending_until = math.max(tonumber(st.pending_until or 0) or 0, _now() + pending) end

end
function L.ready(lane) lane = tostring(lane or ""):lower() if lane == "ent" or lane == "entity" then lane = "class" end local st = L._lane[lane] local now = _now() if st and tonumber(st.pending_until or 0) > now then return false end if lane == "eq" then local v = nil
if Yso.state and type(Yso.state.eq_ready)=="function" then
local ok, r = pcall(Yso.state.eq_ready)
if ok and r ~= nil then v = (r == true) end
end
if v ~= nil then return v end
-- The state helper is optional in the package runtime. Do not let -- the short send guard expiring stand in for equilibrium regain. local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local vitals = g and g.Char and g.Char.Vitals or {} local eq = vitals.eq if eq == nil then eq = vitals.equilibrium end return eq == true or tostring(eq) == "1" elseif lane == "bal" then local v = nil
if Yso.state and type(Yso.state.bal_ready)=="function" then
local ok, r = pcall(Yso.state.bal_ready)
if ok and r ~= nil then v = (r == true) end
end
if v ~= nil then return v end
local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local vitals = g and g.Char and g.Char.Vitals or {} local bal = vitals.bal if bal == nil then bal = vitals.balance end return bal == true or tostring(bal) == "1" elseif lane == "class" then if st and tonumber(st.backoff_until or 0) > now then return false end local v = nil
if Yso.state and type(Yso.state.ent_ready)=="function" then
local ok, r = pcall(Yso.state.ent_ready)
if ok and r ~= nil then v = (r == true) end
end
if v ~= nil then return v end
return true end return true end
function L.eq_ready() return L.ready("eq") end function L.bal_ready() return L.ready("bal") end function L.ent_ready() return L.ready("class") end end end
-- ----------------- trace ring (introspection) ----------------- Yso.trace = Yso.trace or {} do local T = Yso.trace T.max = tonumber(T.max or 200) or 200 if T.max < 1 then T.max = 1 end T.buf = T.buf or {} T.idx = tonumber(T.idx or 0) or 0
local function _push(entry) if type(entry) ~= "table" then entry = { msg = tostring(entry) } end entry.ts = entry.ts or (Yso.util and Yso.util.now and Yso.util.now()) or os.time() T.idx = (T.idx % T.max) + 1 T.buf[T.idx] = entry end
function T.push(kind, entry) entry = entry or {} entry.kind = kind or entry.kind or "log" _push(entry) end
function T.dump(n) n = tonumber(n) or T.max if n <= 0 then return {} end local out = {} local count = math.min(n, #T.buf, T.max) local start = T.idx - count + 1 for i = 0, count-1 do local j = start + i if j <= 0 then j = j + T.max end out[#out+1] = T.buf[j] end return out end
function T.echo(n) local rows = T.dump(n) if type(cecho) ~= "function" then return rows end cecho("<dim_grey>[Yso.trace] last "..tostring(#rows).."\n") for i=1,#rows do local e = rows[i] or {} local ts = tostring(e.ts or "") local k = tostring(e.kind or "") local r = tostring(e.reason or e.src or e.msg or "") cecho(string.format("<dim_grey> %s %-6s %s\n", ts, k, r)) end return rows end end
-- ----------------- global payload mode ----------------- Yso.cfg = Yso.cfg or {} -- Default payload mode unless a session value was already set. if type(Yso.cfg.payload_mode) ~= "string" or Yso.cfg.payload_mode == "" then Yso.cfg.payload_mode = "as_available" end
function Yso.get_payload_mode() Yso.cfg = Yso.cfg or {} local mode = tostring(Yso.cfg.payload_mode or ""):lower() if mode ~= "paired" then mode = "as_available" end Yso.cfg.payload_mode = mode return mode end
function Yso.set_payload_mode(mode, quiet) Yso.cfg = Yso.cfg or {} local next_mode = tostring(mode or ""):lower() if next_mode ~= "paired" and next_mode ~= "as_available" then next_mode = "as_available" end Yso.cfg.payload_mode = next_mode

-- ----------------- unified emitter (RAW, lane-aware) ----------------- Yso.lanes = Yso.lanes or {} function Yso.lanes.normalize(lane) lane = tostring(lane or ""):lower() if lane == "ent" or lane == "entity" then return "class" end if lane == "pre" then return "free" end return lane end

function Yso.pause_offense(on, reason, quiet) local P = Yso.pause.offense on = (on == true)
if on then P.active = true P.reason = tostring(reason or P.reason or "paused") P.at = (Yso.util and type(Yso.util.now) == "function" and Yso.util.now()) or os.time() else P.active = false P.reason = "" P.at = 0 end

if not quiet and type(cecho) == "function" then if on then cecho(string.format("<orange>[Yso] Offense PAUSED<reset> (%s)\n", tostring(P.reason))) else cecho("<orange>[Yso] Offense RESUMED<reset>\n") end end

-- ----------------- manual inhibit (400ms window) ----------------- -- Blocks offense automation from committing when the player sends a -- manual offense command (alias or keyword-detected send). -- Offense keyword patterns for detecting manual commands in send(). local _OFFENSE_KW = { "^%s*instill%s", "^%s*bodywarp%s", "^%s*shrivel%s", "command%s+%w+%s+at%s", "fling%s+%w+%s+at%s", }

local function _trim(s) return tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function _lane_text(v) if type(v) == "table" then local out = {} for i = 1, #v do local part = _trim(v[i]) if part ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = part end end return table.concat(out, (Yso and (Yso.sep or (Yso.cfg and (Yso.cfg.cmd_sep or Yso.cfg.pipe_sep)))) or "&&") end return _trim(v) end

local function _emit_direct(payload) local cmds = {} if type(payload) == "string" then local line = _trim(payload) if line ~= "" then cmds[1] = line end elseif type(payload) == "table" then local free = _lane_text(payload.free or payload.pre) local eq = _lane_text(payload.eq) local bal = _lane_text(payload.bal) local class = _lane_text(payload.class or payload.ent or payload.entity) if free ~= "" then cmds[#cmds + 1] = free end if eq ~= "" then cmds[#cmds + 1] = eq end if bal ~= "" then cmds[#cmds + 1] = bal end if class ~= "" then cmds[#cmds + 1] = class end if #cmds == 0 and payload[1] ~= nil then for i = 1, #payload do local line = _trim(payload[i]) if line ~= "" then cmds[#cmds + 1] = line end end end end if #cmds == 0 then return false end local any = false for i = 1, #cmds do if Yso.send(cmds[i]) then any = true end end return any end

if not allow_non_offense then local has_lane = false if type(payload) == "table" then if payload.eq ~= nil or payload.bal ~= nil or payload.class ~= nil or payload.ent ~= nil or payload.entity ~= nil then has_lane = true end end
local is_offense = (kind == "offense") or reason:find("offense", 1, true) or reason:find("group_damage", 1, true) or reason:find("gd:", 1, true) or reason:find("limb", 1, true)
if is_offense or has_lane then return false end end end
local Q = (Yso and Yso.queue) if not (Q and type(Q.stage)=="function" and type(Q.commit)=="function") then if Q and type(Q.emit)=="function" then return Q.emit(payload, opts) end local sent_direct = _emit_direct(payload) if sent_direct == true and type(payload) == "table" and _trim(payload.eq) ~= "" then -- Keep EQ history across later free/balance/entity acknowledgements. -- ----------------- tiny helpers (CURING) ----------------- local function _cure_echo(msg) if Yso and Yso.curing and Yso.curing.debug then cecho(string.format("<cyan>[Yso:Cure] <reset>%s\n", msg)) end end

local function _cure_err(msg) cecho(string.format("<red>[Yso:Cure:ERR] <reset>%s\n", msg)) end
local function _send(cmd) if not cmd or cmd == "" then return end if type(send) == "function" then send(cmd, false) else _cure_err("send() not available to send: "..cmd) end end
-- ----------------- config / adapters -----------------
