local target_text = _trim(target) if target_text == "" then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Adjustment target is required.") end return nil end
local phial_id = _normalize_phial_id(target_text) if phial_id then target_text = phial_id else target_text = _normalize_compound_key(target_text) end
return string.format("%s %s OF %s", action_key:upper(), axis_key:upper(), target_text:upper()) end
function F.send_adjustment(action, axis, target) local cmd = F.build_adjustment(action, axis, target) if not cmd then return nil end if type(send) == "function" then send(cmd) end return cmd end
function F.build_role_amalgamate(role, compound) local policy, err = F.reserved_role(role) if not policy then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(err) end return nil end
if next(F.phials or {}) == nil then if type(F.request_discovery) == "function" then F.request_discovery() end if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: phiallist is unknown. Run PHIALLIST.") end return nil end
local desired_compound = _normalize_compound_key(compound or policy.expected_compound or "") if desired_compound == "" then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(policy.label .. " helper needs a compound.") end return nil end
if policy.expected_compound and desired_compound ~= policy.expected_compound then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(policy.label .. " helper expects " .. policy.expected_compound:sub(1, 1):upper() .. policy.expected_compound:sub(2) .. ".") end return nil end
if policy.expected_pool then local ok = policy.expected_pool[desired_compound] == true if not ok then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Offensive gas flex pool excludes " .. desired_compound:sub(1, 1):upper() .. desired_compound:sub(2) .. ".") end return nil end end
local slot = F.phials[policy.id] if not slot then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: " .. policy.id .. " is missing from current phiallist. Run PHIALLIST.") end if type(F.request_discovery) == "function" then F.request_discovery() end return nil end
if not slot.empty then local msg = string.format("%s slot mismatch: %s currently holds %s. Use EMPTY %s when ready.", policy.label, policy.id, tostring(slot.compound or "?"), policy.id:upper()) if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(msg) end return nil end
local empties = F.empty_phials() if #empties ~= 1 or empties[1].id ~= policy.id then if #empties > 1 then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: multiple empty phials detected (" .. _join_ids(empties) .. "). Keep only " .. policy.id .. " empty before AMALGAMATE " .. desired_compound:upper() .. ".") end return nil end if #empties == 0 then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: " .. policy.id .. " is not empty. Use EMPTY " .. policy.id:upper() .. " when ready.") end return nil end if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: " .. policy.id .. " must be the only empty phial before AMALGAMATE " .. desired_compound:upper() .. ".") end return nil end
return "AMALGAMATE " .. desired_compound:upper(), { role = policy.role, role_label = policy.label, phial_id = policy.id, compound = desired_compound, } end
function F.send_role_amalgamate(role, compound) local cmd, context = F.build_role_amalgamate(role, compound) if not cmd then return nil end
if type(send) == "function" then send(cmd) send("phiallist") end F.state.last_amalgamate = { cmd = cmd, role = context and context.role, phial_id = context and context.phial_id, compound = context and context.compound, at = type(F.now) == "function" and F.now() or os.time(), } return cmd, context end
function F.build_role_amalgamate_autofix(role, compound) local policy, err = F.reserved_role(role) if not policy then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(err) end return nil end
if next(F.phials or {}) == nil then if type(F.request_discovery) == "function" then F.request_discovery() end if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: phiallist is unknown. Run PHIALLIST.") end return nil end
local desired_compound = _normalize_compound_key(compound or policy.expected_compound or "") if desired_compound == "" then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(policy.label .. " helper needs a compound.") end return nil end
if policy.expected_compound and desired_compound ~= policy.expected_compound then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(policy.label .. " helper expects " .. policy.expected_compound:sub(1, 1):upper() .. policy.expected_compound:sub(2) .. ".") end return nil end
if policy.expected_pool then local ok = policy.expected_pool[desired_compound] == true if not ok then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Offensive gas flex pool excludes " .. desired_compound:sub(1, 1):upper() .. desired_compound:sub(2) .. ".") end return nil end end
local slot = F.phials[policy.id] if not slot then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Unsafe Amalgamate state: " .. policy.id .. " is missing from current phiallist. Run PHIALLIST.") end if type(F.request_discovery) == "function" then F.request_discovery() end return nil end
local cmd = "AMALGAMATE " .. desired_compound:upper() local empties = F.empty_phials()
if #empties == 1 and empties[1].id == policy.id and slot.empty then return cmd, { role = policy.role, role_label = policy.label, phial_id = policy.id, compound = desired_compound, autofix = false, prefill_count = 0, } end
local plan = {} for _ = 1, #empties do plan[#plan + 1] = cmd end plan[#plan + 1] = "EMPTY " .. policy.id:upper() plan[#plan + 1] = cmd
if type(F.warn) == "function" and #empties > 1 then F.warn("Autofix: pre-filling " .. tostring(#empties) .. " empty phials before reserving " .. policy.id .. " for " .. desired_compound:upper() .. ".") end
return plan, { role = policy.role, role_label = policy.label, phial_id = policy.id, compound = desired_compound, autofix = true, prefill_count = #empties, } end
function F.send_role_amalgamate_autofix(role, compound) local plan, context = F.build_role_amalgamate_autofix(role, compound) if not plan then return nil end
if type(send) == "function" then if type(plan) == "table" then for i = 1, #plan do send(plan[i]) end else send(plan) end send("phiallist") end
F.state.last_amalgamate = { cmd = type(plan) == "table" and table.concat(plan, " && ") or tostring(plan), role = context and context.role, phial_id = context and context.phial_id, compound = context and context.compound, autofix = context and context.autofix == true, prefill_count = context and context.prefill_count or 0, at = type(F.now) == "function" and F.now() or os.time(), } return plan, context end
function F.send_amalgamate_autofix(compound) local role, normalized = _amalgamate_role_for_compound(compound) if normalized == "" then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Autofix amalgamate helper needs a compound.") end return nil end return F.send_role_amalgamate_autofix(role, normalized) end
function F.build_endorphin_amalgamate() return F.build_role_amalgamate("endorphin", "endorphin") end
function F.build_enhancement_amalgamate() return F.build_role_amalgamate("enhancement", "enhancement") end
function F.build_offensive_gas_amalgamate(compound) return F.build_role_amalgamate("offensive_flex", compound) end
function F.send_endorphin_amalgamate() return F.send_role_amalgamate("endorphin", "endorphin") end
function F.send_enhancement_amalgamate() return F.send_role_amalgamate("enhancement", "enhancement") end
function F.send_offensive_gas_amalgamate(compound) return F.send_role_amalgamate("offensive_flex", compound) end
function F.send_endorphin_amalgamate_autofix() return F.send_role_amalgamate_autofix("endorphin", "endorphin") end
function F.send_enhancement_amalgamate_autofix() return F.send_role_amalgamate_autofix("enhancement", "enhancement") end
function F.send_offensive_gas_amalgamate_autofix(compound) return F.send_role_amalgamate_autofix("offensive_flex", compound) end
function F.show_phials() local ids = {} for id in pairs(F.phials) do ids[#ids + 1] = id end table.sort(ids)
if #ids == 0 then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("No known phials.") end return {} end
local lines = {} for _, id in ipairs(ids) do local row = F.phials[id] local permanence = row.permanent and " permanent" or "" if row.empty then lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("%s -> Empty (%s months%s, qty %s)", id, tostring(row.months or "?"), permanence, tostring(row.quantity or "?")) else lines[#lines + 1] = string.format( "%s -> %s (%s months%s, p%s v%s s%s)", id, tostring(row.compound or "?"), tostring(row.months or "?"), permanence, tostring(row.potency or "?"), tostring(row.volatility or "?"), tostring(row.stability or "?") ) end end
if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn("Known phials:\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")) end return lines end

Script.name: formulation_build
Script.script:
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.alc = Yso.alc or {} Yso.alc.form = Yso.alc.form or {}
local F = Yso.alc.form
local function _trim(s) s = tostring(s or "") s = s:gsub("^%s+", "") s = s:gsub("%s+$", "") return s end
-- Commands are case-insensitive; we intentionally uppercase complete tokens. local function _upper(s) return tostring(s or ""):upper() end
local function _combine(parts) local out = {} for _, part in ipairs(parts) do if part and part ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = part end end return table.concat(out, " " .. ((type(F.sep) == "function" and F.sep()) or "&&") .. " ") end
local function _normalize_phial_id(raw) if type(F.normalize_phial_id) == "function" then return F.normalize_phial_id(raw) end local value = _trim(raw) local digits = value:match("^[Pp][Hh][Ii][Aa][Ll](%d+)$") or value:match("^(%d+)$") if not digits then return nil end return "Phial" .. digits end
function F.ensure_wielded(phial) if not phial or not phial.compound or phial.compound == "" then return nil end
local target_id = _normalize_phial_id(phial.id) local eq_hands = F.state and F.state.eq_hands or nil local held_target = false local foreign_phials = {} if type(eq_hands) == "table" then for _, hand in pairs(eq_hands) do local held = hand and _normalize_phial_id(hand.phial_id or hand.token or "") if held then if held == target_id then held_target = true else foreign_phials[#foreign_phials + 1] = held end end end end
local parts = {} if #foreign_phials > 0 then table.sort(foreign_phials) for _, held in ipairs(foreign_phials) do parts[#parts + 1] = "UNWIELD " .. held:upper() end end
if not held_target or #foreign_phials > 0 then if target_id then parts[#parts + 1] = "WIELD " .. target_id:upper() else parts[#parts + 1] = "WIELD " .. _upper(phial.compound) end end
F.state.last_wielded = { id = phial.id, compound = phial.compound, at = type(F.now) == "function" and F.now() or os.time(), }
if #parts == 0 then return nil end return _combine(parts) end
local function _build_action(meta, arg) local name = _upper(meta.use_name or meta.name) local use_arg = _trim(arg)
if meta.delivery == "wield_throw" or meta.delivery == "room_throw" then if use_arg == "" then if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(meta.name .. " needs 'ground' or a direction.") end return nil end if use_arg:lower() == "ground" or use_arg:lower() == "at ground" then return "THROW " .. name .. " AT GROUND" end return "THROW " .. name .. " " .. _upper(use_arg) end
if meta.delivery == "imbibe_or_administer" then if use_arg == "" then return "IMBIBE " .. name end return "ADMINISTER " .. name .. " " .. use_arg end
if meta.delivery == "imbibe" then if use_arg ~= "" and type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(meta.name .. " does not take a target.") return nil end return "IMBIBE " .. name end
if meta.delivery == "special_self_imbibe" then if use_arg ~= "" and type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(meta.name .. " does not take a target.") return nil end return "IMBIBE " .. name end
if meta.delivery == "enhanced_state_ability" then if use_arg ~= "" and type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(meta.name .. " does not take a target.") return nil end return name end
if type(F.warn) == "function" then F.warn(meta.name .. " is manual/utility right now.") end return nil end
function F.build_use(name, arg) local meta = type(F.resolve) == "function" and F.resolve(name) or nil if not meta then return nil end
local needs_phial = meta.delivery ~= "enhanced_state_ability" and meta.delivery ~= "utility" local phial if needs_phial then phial = type(F.require_phial) == "function" and F.require_phial(meta.use_name or meta.name) or nil if not phial then return nil end end
local action = _build_action(meta, arg) if not action then return nil end
local parts = {} if meta.needs_wield then parts[#parts + 1] = F.ensure_wielded(phial) end parts[#parts + 1] = action
return _combine(parts), { meta = meta, phial = phial, action = action, } end

Script.name: formulation_chart
Script.script:
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.alc = Yso.alc or {} Yso.alc.form = Yso.alc.form or {}
local F = Yso.alc.form
F.chart_rows = F.chart_rows or { { "Endorphin", "healing gas" }, { "Nutritional", "nutrition/administer supplement" }, { "Corrosive", "aoe shield break" }, { "Petrifying", "physical resist, lightning weakness" }, { "Incendiary", "burning room gas" }, { "Alteration", "adjust/amalgamate compounds" }, { "Devitalisation", "max health drain gas" }, { "Intoxicant", "lung paralysis gas" }, { "Vaporisation", "remove flooded/iced room" }, { "Phosphorous", "strong blindness flash" }, { "Monoxide", "disorient/prone/balance loss" }, { "Toxin", "vyoria plague gas" }, { "Concussive", "room knockback explosion" }, { "Mayology", "destructive speed serum; fatal" }, { "Halophilic", "special vine killer" }, { "Enhancement", "durability/self-control form" }, { "Bolster", "enhanced-form heal" }, }
local function _pad(text, width) text = tostring(text or "") return text .. string.rep(" ", math.max(0, width - #text)) end
local function _strip_tags(text) return tostring(text or ""):gsub("<[^>]*>", "") end
function F.show_chart() local win = "Yso_Formulation_Chart" local rows = F.chart_rows or {}
local function out(line) line = tostring(line or "") if type(cecho) == "function" then cecho(win, line .. "\n") elseif type(echo) == "function" then echo(win, _strip_tags(line) .. "\n") end end
if type(openUserWindow) == "function" then openUserWindow(win, false, false, "f")
if type(setUserWindowTitle) == "function" then pcall(setUserWindowTitle, win, "Formulation Chart") end
if type(resizeWindow) == "function" then pcall(resizeWindow, win, 620, 430) end
if type(setFontSize) == "function" then pcall(setFontSize, win, 10) end
if type(setWindowWrap) == "function" then pcall(setWindowWrap, win, 90) end
if type(clearWindow) == "function" then clearWindow(win) end
out("<gold>[FORMULATION:] <aquamarine>Quick effect chart") out("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58)) out("<gold>" .. _pad("Skill", 18) .. " <aquamarine>Effect") out("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58))
for _, row in ipairs(rows) do out("<white>" .. _pad(row[1], 18) .. " <aquamarine>" .. row[2]) end
out("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58)) out("<aquamarine>Alias: <white>fchart") return end
-- Main-window fallback if user windows are unavailable. cecho("\n<gold>[FORMULATION:] <aquamarine>Quick effect chart\n") cecho("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58) .. "\n") cecho("<gold>" .. _pad("Skill", 18) .. " <aquamarine>Effect\n") cecho("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58) .. "\n")
for _, row in ipairs(rows) do cecho("<white>" .. _pad(row[1], 18) .. " <aquamarine>" .. row[2] .. "\n") end
cecho("<gray>" .. string.rep("-", 58) .. "\n") end

Script.name: formulation_phiallist
Monk reference
Mind lock tracking
Script.script:
-- Confirmed Telepathy lock state; attempts never authorize an execute. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.mindlock = Yso.monk.mindlock or {} local L = Yso.monk.mindlock
local function same_name(a, b) return type(a) == "string" and type(b) == "string" and a:lower() == b:lower() end
local function wake(reason) if Yso.pulse and type(Yso.pulse.wake) == "function" then Yso.pulse.wake(reason) end if Yso.mode and type(Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop) == "function" then Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop(nil, reason) end end
function L.attempt(name) if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return end L.pending_target = name L.locked_target = nil wake("monk:mindlock_attempt") end
function L.confirm(name) if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return end L.locked_target = name -- A delayed confirmation must not erase a newer target's attempt. if same_name(name, L.pending_target) then L.pending_target = nil end wake("monk:mindlock_success") end
function L.release(name) if same_name(name, L.locked_target) then L.locked_target = nil end if same_name(name, L.pending_target) then L.pending_target = nil end wake("monk:mindlock_release") end
function L.is_locked(name) return same_name(name, L.locked_target) end
function L.reset() L.pending_target = nil L.locked_target = nil wake("monk:mindlock_reset") end
-- Never restore a confirmed lock from an earlier connection or script load. L.reset() L._handlers = L._handlers or {} if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then for _, event in ipairs({ "sysConnectionEvent", "sysDisconnectionEvent" }) do if L._handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then killAnonymousEventHandler(L._handlers[event]) end L._handlers[event] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, L.reset) end end

Script.name: Scythe logic
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Monk scythe -- MIND SCYTHE has no target argument. -- Gate: mangled head (affstrack.score.head >= 200) and at least -- two of stupidity, impatience, dizziness, epilepsy, confusion. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.scythe = Yso.monk.scythe or {}
local S = Yso.monk.scythe
local FALLBACK_POOL = { "stupidity", "impatience", "dizziness", "epilepsy", "confusion" }
local function _entry() local ref = Yso.ref and Yso.ref.monk local row = ref and ref.telepathy and ref.telepathy.scythe if type(row) == "table" then return row end return nil end
local function _pool() local row = _entry() local pool = row and row.mental_pool if type(pool) == "table" and #pool > 0 then return pool end return FALLBACK_POOL end
local function _min_count() local row = _entry() return tonumber(row and row.mental_pool_min) or 2 end
local function _resolve_target(target) target = tostring(target or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if target ~= "" then return target end if Yso and type(Yso.get_target) == "function" then local ok, who = pcall(Yso.get_target) if ok then who = tostring(who or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if who ~= "" then return who end end end local g = rawget(_G, "target") if type(g) == "string" and g ~= "" then return g end return "" end
local function _has_aff(name) if Yso and Yso.ak and type(Yso.ak.has) == "function" then local ok, v = pcall(Yso.ak.has, name) if ok and v == true then return true end if ok then return false end end local scores = rawget(_G, "affstrack") scores = scores and scores.score if type(scores) ~= "table" then return false end return (tonumber(scores[name]) or 0) >= 100 end
local function _mangled_head() local scores = rawget(_G, "affstrack") scores = scores and scores.score if type(scores) ~= "table" then return false end return (tonumber(scores.head) or 0) >= 200 end
function S.ready(target) if _resolve_target(target) == "" then return false end if not _mangled_head() then return false end local seen = {} local count = 0 for _, name in ipairs(_pool()) do name = tostring(name or ""):lower() if name ~= "" and not seen[name] and _has_aff(name) then seen[name] = true count = count + 1 end end return count >= _min_count() end
function S.execute(target) if not S.ready(target) then return false end if type(send) ~= "function" then return false end send("mind scythe") return true end

Script.name: Kai resource
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Monk Kai resource -- gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats is a list of "Label: value" strings. -- Tekura: { "Bleed: 0", "Rage: 0", "Kai: 0%", "Stance: None" } -- Shikudo adds "Form: <name>" and "Kata: <number>". Both vary. -- Hadoken() reads current GMCP Kai (0 when unavailable). -- hadoken remains a numeric compatibility mirror. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.kai = Yso.monk.kai or {}
local K = Yso.monk.kai
-- Server-confirmed cooldown and channel state; neither changes Kai amounts. K.burst = K.burst or {} K.deliverance = K.deliverance or {state = "idle"} local D = K.deliverance
function K.on_burst(result) if result == "used" or result == "cooldown" then K.burst.ready = false elseif result == "ready" then K.burst.ready = true end K.burst.last_result = result end
local function _curing() return Legacy and Legacy.Settings and Legacy.Settings.Curing end
local function _cancel_confirmation() D.generation = (D.generation or 0) + 1 if D.timer and type(killTimer) == "function" then killTimer(D.timer) end D.timer = nil end
local function _restore_curing() local owned = D.paused_curing D.paused_curing = false local curing = _curing() if owned and curing and curing.status == false then expandAlias("pp") end end
function K.on_deliverance(state) if state ~= "idle" and state ~= "channeling" and state ~= "active" then return end _cancel_confirmation() D.state = state if state == "idle" then _restore_curing() end end
function K.start_deliverance() if D.state ~= "idle" then return false, "deliverance_busy" end if (tonumber(rawget(_G, "hadoken")) or 0) <= 81 then return false, "insufficient_kai" end local self = Yso.self if type(self) ~= "table" or type(self.has_aff) ~= "function" or type(self.is_prone) ~= "function" then return false, "self_state_unavailable" end if self.has_aff("paralysis") then return false, "paralysis" end if self.is_prone() then return false, "prone" end local curing = _curing() if not curing or type(curing.status) ~= "boolean" or type(expandAlias) ~= "function" or type(send) ~= "function" or type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then return false, "curing_unavailable" end
D.state = "pending" D.paused_curing = curing.status == true _cancel_confirmation() local generation = D.generation D.timer = tempTimer(5, function() if D.generation == generation and D.state == "pending" then K.on_deliverance("idle") end end) -- pp is a toggle: never resume a system that was already paused. if D.paused_curing then expandAlias("pp") end send("kai deliverance") return true end
K.current = tonumber(K.current) or 0 if _G.hadoken == nil then _G.hadoken = K.current end
local function _label_value(entry) local label, value = tostring(entry or ""):match("^(.-):%s*(.*)$") if not label then return "", "" end label = label:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower() value = tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") return label, value end
local function _kai_value(list) if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end for _, entry in ipairs(list) do local label, value = _label_value(entry) if label == "kai" then local n = tonumber((value:gsub("%%$", ""))) if n and n == n and n ~= math.huge and n ~= -math.huge then return math.max(0, math.min(100, n)) end return 0 end end return 0 end
function K.apply_charstats(list) K.current = _kai_value(list) _G.hadoken = K.current if type(list) ~= "table" then return K.current end local stance = Yso.monk and Yso.monk.stance if stance and type(stance.apply_charstats) == "function" then stance.apply_charstats(list) end local shikudo = Yso.monk and Yso.monk.shikudo if shikudo and type(shikudo.apply_charstats) == "function" then shikudo.apply_charstats(list) end return K.current end
local function _on_vitals() local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local stats = g and g.Char and g.Char.Vitals and g.Char.Vitals.charstats return K.apply_charstats(stats) end
function Hadoken() local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local stats = g and g.Char and g.Char.Vitals and g.Char.Vitals.charstats -- Reading Kai must not reapply potentially older form/kata confirmations. K.current = _kai_value(stats) _G.hadoken = K.current return K.current end
if K._eh and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then killAnonymousEventHandler(K._eh) K._eh = nil end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" and not K._eh then K._eh = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", _on_vitals) end Hadoken()

Script.name: Bashing script
Script.script: -- Defines both the namespaced function and the legacy entry point used by shunt. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.shikudo = Yso.monk.shikudo or {} local F = Yso.monk.shikudo -- Hunting combos use reference-legal strikes and at most one kick. -- Gaital's sweep spends both arm balances, so that combo is one strike plus a kick. local attacks = { willow = 'hiru hiraku flashheel right', rain = 'ruku torso kuro left frontkick left', oak = 'livestrike nervestrike risingkick head', tykonos = 'thrust head thrust head risingkick head', gaital = 'sweep spinkick', maelstrom = 'livestrike ruku torso risingkick torso', } -- Denizen output uses a full name, while shunt may use a keyword or item ID. -- Mirror the observed name and resolved target through the AK shield API. function F.track_shield(name, up) if not Yso.shield or type(Yso.shield.set) ~= 'function' then return false end local who = rawget(_G, 'target') if (who == nil or tostring(who) == '') and type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' then who = Yso.get_target() end local key = tostring(who or ''):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') local full = tostring(name or ''):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if key == '' or full == '' then return false end if key:match('^%d+$') then local room = Legacy and Legacy.Room local mobs = room and room.mobs local mob_name if type(mobs) == 'table' then -- Legacy maintains this room map through List/Add/Remove events. -- Missing IDs are authoritative; do not revive them from an old List. mob_name = mobs[key] or mobs[tonumber(key)] else local items = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Items local packet = items and items.List if type(packet) == 'table' and packet.location == 'room' and type(packet.items) == 'table' then for _, item in pairs(packet.items) do if type(item) == 'table' and tostring(item.id) == key then mob_name = item.name break end end end end mob_name = tostring(mob_name or ''):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if mob_name == '' or mob_name ~= full then return false end elseif full ~= key and not (' ' .. full .. ' '):find(' ' .. key .. ' ', 1, true) then return false end Yso.shield.set(full, up, 'shikudo:shield_line') Yso.shield.set(who, up, 'shikudo:shield_line') return true end local next_form = {willow='rain',rain='oak',oak='willow',tykonos='willow',gaital='rain',maelstrom='oak'} local threshold = {willow=9,rain=5,oak=5,tykonos=5,gaital=9,maelstrom=5} function F.bash() if type(F.resolve_target) ~= 'function' or type(F.staff_command) ~= 'function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Load My Shikudo stance? (form and inventory tracking).<reset>\n') return false end local who = F.resolve_target() if not who then return false end local wield = F.staff_command() if not wield then return false end local form = F.form or shikudoForm or shikudostance local count = tonumber(F.kata) or tonumber(kata) or tonumber(katachain) or 0 local cmd if not attacks[form] then cmd = wield .. '&&adopt willow form' else local combo = attacks[form] -- TRANSITION is the final combo argument, after the current form's attacks. -- These combos attempt their listed actions; GMCP confirms the actual resulting -- form/kata (a kill or interrupted combo may prevent the transition). -- Require the five-action minimum already confirmed by game output; -- attempted strikes may miss, be blocked, or stop early on a kill. if count >= 5 and count + 3 >= threshold[form] then combo = combo .. ' transition ' .. next_form[form] end cmd = wield .. '&&combo ' .. who .. ' ' .. combo end if type(Yso.emit) ~= 'function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Yso.emit is unavailable.<reset>\n') return false end return Yso.emit({bal=cmd},{kind='offense',reason='shikudo:bash',target=who,commit=true}) == true end shikudoBashing = F.bash

Script.name: My Shikudo stance?
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Monk Shikudo form and kata -- gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats while the staff art is active includes -- "Form: <name>" and "Kata: <number>". Both change during play. -- Form is matched to a key in the stances table in the Shikudo scripts. -- Kata is whatever whole number GMCP sends. GMCP is the source of truth. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.shikudo = Yso.monk.shikudo or {}
local F = Yso.monk.shikudo
F.form = F.form F.kata = tonumber(F.kata) or 0
local PROSE_KEYS = { tykonos = "tykonos", willow = "willow", ["willows shaken by the wind"] = "willow", rain = "rain", ["willows in rain storm"] = "rain", oak = "oak", ["live oak"] = "oak", ["the live oak"] = "oak", gaital = "gaital", maelstrom = "maelstrom", ["unrelenting storm"] = "maelstrom", ["the unrelenting storm"] = "maelstrom", }
local function _form_key(word) if PROSE_KEYS[word] then return PROSE_KEYS[word] end local stances = rawget(_G, "stances") if type(stances) ~= "table" then return word end if stances[word] then return word end for key in pairs(stances) do if tostring(key):lower() == word then return key end end return word end
local function _publish() _G.shikudoForm = F.form _G.shikudostance = F.form or "" _G.stance = F.form or "" _G.kata = F.kata _G.katachain = tostring(F.kata) end
-- Text confirmations own banner output; GMCP form updates remain quiet. local FORM_BANNERS = { tykonos = {marks='70,130,180', brackets='112,128,144', title='224,255,255', text='TYKONOS — TURN ASIDE THE BLOW', top='<< | >> << | >>', bottom='<< | >> << | >>'}, willow = {marks='0,100,0', brackets='34,139,34', title='50,205,50', text='WILLOW — SWIFT AS THE WIND', top='>>> >>> >>>', bottom='>>> >>> >>>'}, rain = {marks='47,79,79', brackets='112,128,144', title='192,192,192', text='RAIN — RELENTLESS ASSAULT', top='/// /// ///', bottom='/// /// ///'}, oak = {marks='139,69,19', brackets='178,34,34', title='255,0,0', text='OAK — CRUSHING POWER', top='### === ###', bottom='### === ###'}, gaital = {marks='72,61,139', brackets='112,128,144', title='216,191,216', text='GAITAL — THROUGH THE GUARD', top='... / ... / ...', bottom='... / ... / ...'}, maelstrom = {marks='0,0,139', brackets='112,128,144', title='192,192,192', text='MAELSTROM — THE UNRELENTING STORM', top='~>> ~>> ~>>', bottom='<<~ <<~ <<~'}, }
function F.show_form_banner(form) form = _form_key(tostring(form or ''):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')) local row = FORM_BANNERS[form] if not row or F.form ~= form or F._banner_form == form or type(decho) ~= 'function' then return false end decho('\n<' .. row.marks .. '> ' .. row.top .. '\n' .. '<' .. row.brackets .. '> [ <' .. row.title .. '>' .. row.text .. '<' .. row.brackets .. '> ]\n' .. '<' .. row.marks .. '> ' .. row.bottom .. '\n<r>') F._banner_form = form return true end
function F.set_form(word) local previous = F.form word = tostring(word or ""):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if word == "" or word == "none" then F.form = nil else F.form = _form_key(word) end if F.form ~= previous then F.kata = 0 end -- a new form resets kata if F.form ~= previous or F.form == nil then F._banner_form = nil end _publish() return F.form end
function F.set_kata(n) n = tonumber(n) or 0 if n < 0 then n = 0 end F.kata = n _publish() return F.kata end
function F.apply_charstats(list) if type(list) ~= "table" then return F.form end local form, chain, tekura for _, entry in ipairs(list) do local label, value = tostring(entry or ""):match("^(.-):%s*(.*)$") if label then label = label:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower() if label == "form" then form = value end if label == "kata" then chain = value end if label == "stance" then tekura = value end end end if form ~= nil then F.set_form(form) elseif tekura ~= nil then local key = tostring(tekura):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if PROSE_KEYS[key] then F.set_form(key) else F.set_form('none') F.set_kata(0) end end if chain ~= nil then F.set_kata(chain) end return F.form end
function F.current_form() local stats = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats if type(stats) == 'table' then F.apply_charstats(stats) for _, entry in ipairs(stats) do if tostring(entry):lower():match('^form:%s*') or tostring(entry):lower():match('^stance:%s*') then return F.form end end end for _, value in ipairs({F.form or '', shikudoForm or '', shikudostance or '', stance or ''}) do local key = tostring(value):lower():gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if PROSE_KEYS[key] then if F.form ~= PROSE_KEYS[key] then F.set_form(key) end return F.form end end end
local function _on_vitals() local g = rawget(_G, "gmcp") local stats = g and g.Char and g.Char.Vitals and g.Char.Vitals.charstats F.apply_charstats(stats) end
if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then if F._eh and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == "function" then killAnonymousEventHandler(F._eh) end F._eh = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", _on_vitals) end
-- Inventory IDs are session data; never hard-code a character's item number. local F = Yso.monk.shikudo F.staffs = F.staffs or {}
local function item_id(value) if type(value) == 'table' then value = value.id end local id = tostring(value or ''):match('^(%d+)$') return id end
local function capture(item, partial) if type(item) ~= 'table' then return end local id = item_id(item) if not id then return end local old = F.staffs[id] local name = tostring(item.name or (partial and old and old.name) or '') if not name:lower():match('%f[%a]staff%f[%A]') then F.staffs[id] = nil return end F.staffs[id] = {id=id, name=name, attrib=item.attrib or (old and old.attrib) or ''} end
function F.capture_staffs(packet, action) if type(packet) ~= 'table' or packet.location ~= 'inv' then return end if action == 'List' then if type(packet.items) ~= 'table' then return end F.staffs = {} for _, item in ipairs(packet.items) do capture(item) end elseif action == 'Remove' then local id = item_id(packet.item) if id then F.staffs[id] = nil end else capture(packet.item, action == 'Update') end end
-- Returns a numeric ID string suitable for 'staff' .. id. The material -- selector is independent of the current combat form: rain still uses willow. function F.get_staff_id(material) material = tostring(material or 'willow'):lower() if material == '' then return nil end local ids = {} for id, item in pairs(F.staffs) do if item.name:lower():find(material, 1, true) then ids[#ids+1] = id end end table.sort(ids, function(a,b) return tonumber(a) < tonumber(b) end) for _, id in ipairs(ids) do if F.staffs[id].attrib:find('l',1,true) then return id end end return ids[1] end
function F.refresh_staffs() if type(sendGMCP) == 'function' then sendGMCP('Char.Items.Inv ""') end end
function F.staff_command() local configured = tostring(rawget(_G, 'shikstaff') or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '') if configured ~= '' then if configured:match('^staff%d+$') then return 'wield ' .. configured end if type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Set shikstaff to a staff item name such as staff123.<reset>\n') end return nil end local id = F.get_staff_id('willow') if id then return 'wield staff' .. id end F.refresh_staffs() if type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] No willow staff found in inventory. Refresh requested; retry after it arrives.<reset>\n') end end
function F.resolve_target() local who = rawget(_G,'target') if (who == nil or tostring(who) == '') and type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' then local ok, value = pcall(Yso.get_target) if ok then who = value end end who = tostring(who or ''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') if who == '' or who:find('[|\r\n]') then cecho('<orange>[SHIKUDO] Set a target first.<reset>\n') return nil end return who end
F._inventory_handlers = F._inventory_handlers or {} local function bind(event, fn) if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= 'function' then return end if F._inventory_handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(F._inventory_handlers[event]) end F._inventory_handlers[event] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event,fn) end for _, action in ipairs({'List','Add','Update','Remove'}) do local kind = action bind('gmcp.Char.Items.' .. kind, function() local items = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Items F.capture_staffs(items and items[kind], kind) end) end local function clear_session() F.staffs = {} F.set_form('none') F.set_kata(0) end bind('sysDisconnectionEvent', clear_session) bind('sysConnectionEvent', function() clear_session(); F.refresh_staffs() end) local items = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Items if items then F.capture_staffs(items.List,'List') end F.apply_charstats(gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals and gmcp.Char.Vitals.charstats) if gmcp and gmcp.Char then F.refresh_staffs() end
-- Initialize flags without overwriting live state on a script reload. for _, name in ipairs({'targshield','tpla','tpll','tph','tpto','tpra','tprl'}) do if rawget(_G,name) == nil then _G[name] = false end end

Script.name: Combo logic
Script.script:
--========================================================-- -- Monk combo -- Caller passes the kick and two punches. This builds the -- COMBO string and does not send it. -- left/right is filled only for strikes whose syntax takes it. --========================================================--
Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.combo = Yso.monk.combo or {}
local C = Yso.monk.combo
local LIMB_KEYS = { legs = { "leftleg", "rightleg" }, arms = { "leftarm", "rightarm" }, }
local function _lookup(token) local ref = Yso.ref and Yso.ref.monk if not ref or type(ref.lookup) ~= "function" then return nil end return ref.lookup(token) end
local function _score(key) local scores = rawget(_G, "affstrack") scores = scores and scores.score if type(scores) ~= "table" then return 0 end return tonumber(scores[key]) or 0 end
local function _side(limb_side, override) if type(override) == "string" and override ~= "" then local side = override:lower() if side == "left" or side == "right" then return side end end local keys = LIMB_KEYS[limb_side] if not keys then return nil end local best_key, best_score for _, key in ipairs(keys) do local score = _score(key) if score > 0 and score < 200 and (not best_score or score > best_score) then best_key = key best_score = score end end if not best_key then return "left" end if best_key:find("right", 1, true) then return "right" end return "left" end
local function _piece(token, opts) local row = _lookup(token) if not row then return nil, "unknown_strike" end local parts = { row.cmd } if row.needs_direction and type(opts.direction) == "string" and opts.direction ~= "" then parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(opts.direction):lower() end if row.limb_side then local overrides = type(opts.limbs) == "table" and opts.limbs or {} local key = tostring(token or ""):lower() parts[#parts + 1] = _side(row.limb_side, overrides[row.cmd] or overrides[key]) end return parts, row end
local function _append(out, parts) for i = 1, #parts do out[#out + 1] = parts[i] end end
function C.build(target, opts) opts = type(opts) == "table" and opts or {} target = tostring(target or opts.target or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if target == "" then return nil, "no_target" end
local kick_parts, kick = _piece(opts.kick, opts) if not kick_parts then return nil, kick or "bad_kick" end if kick.role ~= "kick" and kick.role ~= "stance" then return nil, "kick_required" end
local p1_parts, p1 = _piece(opts.punch1, opts) if not p1_parts then return nil, p1 or "bad_punch1" end if p1.role ~= "punch" then return nil, "punch1_required" end
local p2_parts, p2 = _piece(opts.punch2, opts) if not p2_parts then return nil, p2 or "bad_punch2" end if p2.role ~= "punch" then return nil, "punch2_required" end
local out = { "combo", target } _append(out, kick_parts) _append(out, p1_parts) _append(out, p2_parts)
local already_jpk = kick.cmd == "jpk" or p1.cmd == "jpk" or p2.cmd == "jpk" if opts.jpk == true and not already_jpk then out[#out + 1] = "jpk" end
return table.concat(out, " ") end
-- Shikudo deliberately uses its own reference namespace: Tekura also has -- COMBO and Sweep, but different balance and form rules. function C.build_shikudo(target, opts) opts = type(opts) == 'table' and opts or {} target = tostring(target or '') if not target:match("^[%a%d_'-]+$") then return nil, 'invalid_target' end local ref = Yso.ref and Yso.ref.monk and Yso.ref.monk.shikudo local form = ref and ref[opts.form] if not form or not form.attacks then return nil, 'unknown_form' end local attacks = opts.attacks if type(attacks) ~= 'table' or #attacks < 1 or #attacks > 3 then return nil, 'attack_count' end local allowed = {shatter=true} for _, key in ipairs(form.attacks) do allowed[key:lower()] = true end local out, kicks, arms = {'combo', target}, 0, 0 for _, piece in ipairs(attacks) do if type(piece) ~= 'string' then return nil, 'invalid_attack' end local key, arg = piece:lower():match('^(%a+)%s*(.-)$') local row = key and ref[key] if not row or not allowed[key] then return nil, 'attack_unavailable' end local role = row.commands[1].role if role ~= 'strike' and role ~= 'kick' then return nil, 'invalid_attack' end local light = arg == 'light' or arg:match('^light%s+') ~= nil if light then if role ~= 'strike' or key == 'sweep' or key == 'shatter' then return nil, 'invalid_light' end arg = arg:gsub('^light%s*', '') end if row.limb_options then if not row.limb_options[arg] then return nil, 'invalid_limb' end elseif arg ~= '' then return nil, 'unexpected_limb' end if role == 'kick' then kicks = kicks + 1 else arms = arms + (key == 'sweep' and 2 or 1) end if kicks > 1 or arms > 2 then return nil, 'balance_slots' end out[#out+1] = key .. (light and ' light' or '') .. (arg ~= '' and (' '..arg) or '') end if opts.transition then if (tonumber(opts.kata) or 0) < 5 then return nil, 'insufficient_kata' end local destination = ref[opts.transition] local legal = false if destination and destination.attacks then for _, name in ipairs(form.transitions or {}) do if name:lower() == opts.transition or name == destination.form_name then legal = true end end end if not legal then return nil, 'invalid_transition' end out[#out+1] = 'transition '..opts.transition end return table.concat(out, ' ') end

Script.name: Shikudo AI logic
Script.script:
-- Confirmed target/form/kata state in; damage-route options out. No sending, -- predicted afflictions, limb damage, kata increments, or mutable decisions. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.shikudo = Yso.monk.shikudo or {} local F = Yso.monk.shikudo F.ai = F.ai or {} local A = F.ai
function A.select(ctx) ctx = type(ctx) == 'table' and ctx or {} local form = tostring(ctx.form or ''):lower() if form == '' or form == 'none' then return {command='adopt rain form',kind='adopt'} end local ref = Yso.ref and Yso.ref.monk and Yso.ref.monk.shikudo if not ref or not ref[form] or not ref[form].attacks then return nil, 'unknown_form' end if ctx.shield ~= true and ctx.dispatch_ready == true then local target = tostring(ctx.target or '') if not target:match("^[%a%d_'-]+$") then return nil, 'invalid_target' end return {command='dispatch '..target,kind='dispatch'} end local kata = tonumber(ctx.kata) or 0 local leg = ctx.leg == 'right' and 'right' or 'left' local arm = ctx.arm == 'right' and 'right' or 'left' local affs = type(ctx.affs) == 'table' and ctx.affs or {} local function has(key) return affs[key] == true or (tonumber(affs[key]) or 0) >= 100 end local attacks, next_form, flow if form == 'rain' then attacks = {'kuro '..leg, 'kuro '..leg, 'frontkick '..arm} if ctx.leg_ready == true or ctx.prone == true then attacks = {'hiru', 'hiru', 'frontkick '..arm} end -- Retain the installed damage route's fast progression at six confirmed -- actions; 24/12 below are conservative policy, not measured game caps. next_form, flow = 'oak', ctx.leg_ready == true or ctx.prone == true or kata >= 6 elseif form == 'oak' then attacks = {has('paralysis') and 'livestrike' or 'nervestrike', 'kuro '..leg, 'risingkick head'} if ctx.leg_ready == true or ctx.prone == true then attacks[2] = 'livestrike' end next_form, flow = 'gaital', true elseif form == 'gaital' then attacks = ctx.prone == true and {'needle', 'needle', 'spinkick'} or {'sweep', 'flashheel '..leg} next_form, flow = 'rain', kata >= 9 elseif form == 'willow' then attacks = {'hiru', has('anorexia') and has('stuttering') and 'hiru' or 'hiraku', 'flashheel '..leg} next_form, flow = 'rain', kata >= 6 elseif form == 'tykonos' then attacks = {'thrust head', 'thrust torso', 'risingkick head'} next_form, flow = 'willow', true elseif form == 'maelstrom' then attacks = {'livestrike', 'ruku torso', 'risingkick torso'} next_form, flow = 'oak', true end if form ~= 'tykonos' and kata + 3 >= (form == 'rain' and 24 or 12) and kata >= 5 then return {command='transition to '..next_form..' form',kind='transition'} end if ctx.shield == true then -- Sweep consumes both staff balances; replace it before inserting Shatter. local strike = form == 'gaital' and 'needle' or attacks[2] local kick = attacks[#attacks] attacks = {'shatter', strike, kick} elseif form == 'rain' and (ctx.leg_ready == true or ctx.prone == true) then -- Preserve the installed order: prone first, then Hiru's prone benefit. attacks = {attacks[3], attacks[1], attacks[2]} end return {form=form, kata=kata, attacks=attacks, transition=flow and kata >= 5 and next_form or nil, kind='combo'} end
-- Legacy callers still ask for only the second staff balance. Resolve through -- the same selector, with absent scores treated as unconfirmed. function shikudostafftwo() local target = type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' and Yso.get_target() or rawget(_G,'target') local selected = type(IsTargetted) == 'function' and IsTargetted(target) local scores = selected and rawget(_G,'affstrack') or nil local affs = scores and scores.score or {} local opts = A.select{form=F.form or rawget(_G,'shikudostance'), kata=F.kata, leg=rawget(_G,'tpll') == true and 'right' or 'left', affs=affs, prone=(tonumber(affs.prone) or 0) >= 100} stafftwo = opts and opts.attacks and opts.attacks[2] or '' return stafftwo end

Script.name: Dispatch execute logic
Script.script:
-- Package script: Dispatch execute logic. Selection only; shdam owns emission. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.shikudo = Yso.monk.shikudo or {} local E = Yso.monk.shikudo.execute or {} Yso.monk.shikudo.execute = E
function E.can_dispatch(target) target = tostring(target or ''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') if not target:match('^[%a%d_\'-]+$') then return false,'invalid_target' end if type(IsTargetted)~='function' or not IsTargetted(target) then return false,'untracked_target' end if not (Yso.ak and type(Yso.ak.has)=='function') then return false,'no_aff_tracker' end -- Route policy requested by the user: prone + crushedthroat, no head gate. -- AK's adapter applies confirmation thresholds; numeric zero is truthy in Lua. if Yso.ak.has('prone')~=true then return false,'not_prone' end if Yso.ak.has('crushedthroat')~=true then return false,'no_crushedthroat' end return true,'dispatch_ready' end return E

Script.name: Shikudo limb bridge
Script.script: -- Read-only adapter. Injury afflictions and limb percentages stay separate. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.monk=Yso.monk or {} local B=Yso.monk.limbs or {observations={}} Yso.monk.limbs=B local mapping={head='head',torso='torso',leftarm='left arm',rightarm='right arm',leftleg='left leg',rightleg='right leg'} function B.snapshot(target) local out={ready=false,source='unavailable',hits={},confidence={}} for key in pairs(mapping) do out.confidence[key]='unknown' end if type(lb)~='table' or type(lb.normalizeName)~='function' then return out end local name=lb.normalizeName(target);local row=name and lb[name] if not row or type(row.hits)~='table' then return out end local meta=row.meta or {};out.source=meta.source or 'unverified' if meta.calibrated~=true and B.observations[name:lower()] then out.source='success_seen:no_numeric_damage' end local complete=true for key,label in pairs(mapping) do local n=tonumber(row.hits[label]) local valid=n and n==n and n>=0 and n<math.huge if valid then out.hits[key]=n end if (meta.uncertain or {})[label] then out.confidence[key]='uncertain' elseif valid and (meta.known or {})[label]==true then out.confidence[key]='known' end if out.confidence[key]~='known' then complete=false end end out.ready=complete if next(meta.uncertain or {}) then out.source='uncertain:'..out.source end return out end function B.note_success(target,strike) target=tostring(target or ''):lower() B.observations[target]=B.observations[target] or {} local data=B.observations[target] data[strike]=(data[strike] or 0)+1 -- Success output proves an effect, not a numerical total or LIGHT modifier. -- Retain it for diagnostics; lb.addHit alone owns measured accumulation. end return B

Script.name: Shikudo duel selector
Script.script: -- Pure duel selection. Percentages plan attacks; only AK confirmations open kills. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.monk = Yso.monk or {} Yso.monk.shikudo = Yso.monk.shikudo or {} local S = {} Yso.monk.shikudo.duel_selector = S local graph = {tykonos={'willow'},willow={'rain'},rain={'oak','tykonos'}, oak={'willow','gaital'},gaital={'rain','maelstrom'},maelstrom={'oak'}} local mental_pool = {'stupidity','impatience','dizziness','epilepsy','confusion'} local function has(c, aff) local v = (c.affs or {})[aff] return v == true or (tonumber(v) or 0) >= 100 end local function limb(c, name) return tonumber((c.limbs or {})[name]) end local function limb_known(c,name) local n=limb(c,name) return n and n==n and n>=0 and n<math.huge and ((c.limb_confidence and c.limb_confidence[name]=='known') or (c.limb_confidence==nil and c.limb_ready==true)) end local function prepped(c, name, hit) local value = limb(c,name) return value and value < 100 and value + hit >= 100 end local function action(command, lane, kind, phase, opts) return {command=command,lane=lane or 'bal',kind=kind or 'combo',phase=phase,opts=opts} end local function combo(c, attacks, phase, overrides, destination) local projected,decisions if c.mode=='lock' then local intent={leftarm='prepare',rightarm='prepare', [c.selected_leg=='rightleg' and 'rightleg' or 'leftleg']='prepare'} for name,value in pairs(overrides or {}) do intent[name]=value end attacks,projected,decisions=S.normalize_attacks(c,attacks,intent) if not attacks then return nil,projected end if #attacks==0 then return nil,'no_safe_attacks' end end local opts={form=c.form,kata=c.kata,attacks=attacks} if destination then opts.transition=destination;opts.destination=destination end local command,why=Yso.monk.combo.build_shikudo(c.target,opts) if not command then return nil,why end local a=action(command,'bal','combo',phase,opts) a.projected_limbs=projected;a.light_decisions=decisions return a end local fillers={tykonos={'thrust light torso','thrust light torso'}, willow={'hiraku light','hiru light'},rain={'ruku light torso','kuro light left'}, oak={'nervestrike light','livestrike light'},gaital={'needle light','ruku light torso'}, maelstrom={'livestrike light','ruku light torso'}} local function next_form(from,to) local queue,seen={{from}},{} while #queue>0 do local path=table.remove(queue,1); local last=path[#path] if last==to then return path[2] end if not seen[last] then seen[last]=true for _,name in ipairs(graph[last] or {}) do local p={}; for i,v in ipairs(path) do p[i]=v end p[#p+1]=name; queue[#queue+1]=p end end end end local function travel(c,to,phase) local destination=next_form(c.form,to) if not destination then return nil,'no_legal_transition' end if (tonumber(c.kata) or 0)<5 then local attacks={} for i,piece in ipairs(fillers[c.form]) do attacks[i]=c.mode=='lock' and c.selected_leg=='rightleg' and piece=='kuro light left' and 'kuro light right' or piece end return combo(c,attacks,phase..'_kata') end return action('transition to '..destination..' form','bal','transition',phase,{destination=destination}) end local function dispatch_ready(c) return has(c,'prone') and has(c,'crushedthroat') and (has(c,'damagedhead') or has(c,'mangledhead') or has(c,'head')) and (has(c,'leftleg') or has(c,'rightleg')) end local function scythe_ready(c) if not has(c,'mangledhead') and (tonumber(c.head_severity) or 0)<200 then return false end local n=0; for _,aff in ipairs(mental_pool) do if has(c,aff) then n=n+1 end end return n>=2 end local function hit_info(c,piece) if type(piece)~='string' then return nil,'invalid_attack' end local key,arg=piece:lower():match('^(%a+)%s*(.-)$') local row=key and Yso.ref.monk.shikudo[key] if not row or not row.commands then return nil,'unknown_attack' end local light=arg=='light' or arg:match('^light%s+')~=nil if light then arg=arg:gsub('^light%s*','') end local role=row.commands[1].role local info={key=key,arg=arg,light=light,role=role,utility=key=='sweep' or key=='shatter'} info.eligible=role=='strike' and not info.utility local damage=row.limb_damage if damage and damage.variants then damage=damage.variants[has(c,'prone') and 'prone' or 'standing'] end if damage then info.limb=damage.limb or (damage.limb_by_side or {})[arg] or (damage.limb_by_choice or {})[arg] if not info.limb and damage.targeting then info.limb=arg:gsub(' ','') end local amount=tonumber((c.hit_damage or {})[key]) or damage.pct if amount and amount==amount and amount>=0 and amount<math.huge then if c.hyperfocus==info.limb and role=='strike' then amount=amount*0.5 end info.amount=amount end end return info end -- Pure policy: process each strike in command order. Projected damage is never -- written to lb or promoted to a confirmed injury/affliction. function S.normalize_attacks(c,attacks,intent) local out,totals,decisions={},{},{} for name,value in pairs(c.limbs or {}) do totals[name]=value end local labels={head='head',torso='torso',leftarm='left arm',rightarm='right arm',leftleg='left leg',rightleg='right leg'} local function pct(n) return string.format('%.2f',n):gsub('0+$',''):gsub('%.$','') end for _,piece in ipairs(attacks) do local info,err=hit_info(c,piece) if not info then return nil,err end local key,name=info.key,info.limb local normal=key..(info.arg~='' and ' '..info.arg or '') local mode=(intent or {})[name] or 'protect' local before=tonumber(totals[name]) local known=name and limb_known(c,name) local after=known and info.amount and before+info.amount local injury=name and has(c,name) local allow=after and not injury and before<100 and (mode=='break' or (mode=='prepare' and after<100-0.000000001)) local label=labels[name] or name or key local title=key:sub(1,1):upper()..key:sub(2) if info.utility then out[#out+1]=normal elseif allow then out[#out+1]=normal;totals[name]=after decisions[#decisions+1]=label..' '..mode..': '..title..' '..pct(before)..'% -> '..pct(after)..'%' else local reason if not known then local confidence=c.limb_confidence and c.limb_confidence[name] or 'unknown' reason=label..' '..tostring(confidence or 'unknown')..' baseline' elseif not info.amount then reason=label..' unknown strike damage' elseif after and mode~='protect' and before<100 and not injury then reason=label..' protected: normal '..title..' would reach '..pct(after)..'%' else reason=label..' protected: '..((injury or (before and before>=100)) and 'already broken' or 'affliction pressure') end if info.eligible then out[#out+1]=key..' light'..(info.arg~='' and ' '..info.arg or '') decisions[#decisions+1]=reason..'; '..title..' LIGHT'..(mode=='break' and ' (break withheld)' or '') elseif info.role=='kick' then decisions[#decisions+1]=reason..'; '..title..' omitted' else return nil,'invalid_attack_role' end end end return out,totals,decisions end -- Read every piece in order, including multiple hits to the same limb. This -- function never writes to the input snapshot or the live limb tracker. function S.project(c, attacks) local totals={}; for k,v in pairs(c.limbs or {}) do totals[k]=v end local ref=Yso.ref.monk.shikudo local prone=has(c,'prone') for _,piece in ipairs(attacks) do local key,arg=piece:match('^(%a+)%s*(.-)$') local row=ref[key]; local damage=row and row.limb_damage local light=arg=='light' or arg:match('^light%s+') if light then arg=arg:gsub('^light%s*','') end if damage and not light then if damage.variants then damage=damage.variants[prone and 'prone' or 'standing'] end local name=damage.limb or (damage.limb_by_side or {})[arg] or (damage.limb_by_choice or {})[arg] if not name and damage.targeting then name=arg:gsub(' ','') end if not name or not damage.pct or totals[name]==nil then return nil,'unknown_limb_damage' end local amount=tonumber((c.hit_damage or {})[key]) or damage.pct if c.hyperfocus==name and row.commands[1].role=='strike' then amount=amount*0.5 end totals[name]=totals[name]+amount end -- Do not assume Sweep/Frontkick successfully prones during a combination. end return totals end local function safe_prep(c, attacks, phase) local totals,why=S.project(c,attacks) if not totals then return nil,why end for _,name in ipairs{'head','leftleg','rightleg'} do if (limb(c,name) or 0)<100 and (totals[name] or 0)>=100 then return nil,'premature_'..name..'_break' end end return combo(c,attacks,phase) end local function lock(c) local legside=c.selected_leg=='rightleg' and 'right' or 'left' if not has(c,'anorexia') then if c.form~='willow' then return travel(c,'willow','refresh_anorexia') end return combo(c,{'hiraku light','hiru light'},'anorexia') end if c.form~='oak' then if c.form=='rain' and (tonumber(c.kata) or 0)<5 then return combo(c,{'ruku light torso','kuro light '..legside},'slickness_weariness') end return travel(c,'oak','oak_lock') end local a if not has(c,'paralysis') then a={'nervestrike light','livestrike light','risingkick torso'} elseif not has(c,'asthma') then a={'livestrike light','ruku light torso','risingkick torso'} elseif not has(c,'slickness') then a={'ruku light torso','nervestrike light','risingkick torso'} elseif not has(c,'impatience') then return action('mind impatience '..c.target,'eq','mental','impatience') elseif not has(c,'weariness') then a={'kuro light '..legside,'ruku light torso','risingkick torso'} elseif limb_known(c,'leftarm') and limb_known(c,'rightarm') and not (has(c,'leftarm') and has(c,'rightarm')) then if (limb(c,'leftarm') or 0)>=100 and (limb(c,'rightarm') or 0)>=100 then return combo(c,{'livestrike light','ruku light torso','risingkick torso'},'awaiting_arm_injuries') end local side=(limb(c,'leftarm') or 0)<=(limb(c,'rightarm') or 0) and 'left' or 'right' return combo(c,{'ruku '..side,'ruku '..side,'risingkick torso'},'riftlock',{[side..'arm']='break'}) elseif not has(c,'addiction') then return travel(c,'gaital','addiction') else a={'livestrike light','ruku light torso','risingkick torso'} end return combo(c,a,'lock_pressure') end local function limb_route(c, fork) if fork and scythe_ready(c) then return action('mind scythe','eq','mental','scythe') end if dispatch_ready(c) then return action('dispatch '..c.target,'bal','dispatch','dispatch') end if not c.limb_ready then return nil,'unverified_limb_feed' end local hit=tonumber((c.hit_damage or {}).kuro) or Yso.ref.monk.shikudo.kuro.limb_damage.pct local headhit=tonumber((c.hit_damage or {}).needle) or Yso.ref.monk.shikudo.needle.limb_damage.pct local function leg_ready(name) return prepped(c,name,hit) or has(c,name) or (limb(c,name) or 0)>=100 end local legs=leg_ready('leftleg') and leg_ready('rightleg') local head=prepped(c,'head',headhit) or has(c,'damagedhead') or has(c,'mangledhead') or has(c,'head') if not legs then if c.form~='rain' then return travel(c,'rain','leg_prep') end local side='left' if leg_ready('leftleg') or (not leg_ready('rightleg') and limb(c,'rightleg')<limb(c,'leftleg')) then side='right' end local attacks={'kuro '..side,'ruku light torso'} return safe_prep(c,attacks,'leg_prep') elseif not head then if c.form~='oak' then return travel(c,'oak','head_prep') end local attacks={'nervestrike','ruku light torso'} local projected=S.project(c,attacks) if projected and projected.head>=100 then attacks[1]='nervestrike light'; attacks[3]='risingkick head' end return safe_prep(c,attacks,'head_prep') end if c.form~='gaital' then return travel(c,'gaital','kill_setup') end if fork and (has(c,'mangledhead') or (tonumber(c.head_severity) or 0)>=200) then if not has(c,'impatience') then return action('mind impatience '..c.target,'eq','mental','scythe_mental') end return action('mind batter '..c.target,'eq','mental','scythe_mental') end local side=has(c,'leftleg') and 'right' or 'left' if not has(c,'prone') then return combo(c,{'sweep','flashheel '..side},'prone_leg_break') end if not has(c,'leftleg') or not has(c,'rightleg') then return combo(c,{'needle','needle','flashheel '..side},'second_leg_head') end return combo(c,{'needle','needle','spinkick'},fork and 'scythe_head' or 'head_windpipe') end local function blackout(c) if dispatch_ready(c) then return action('dispatch '..c.target,'bal','dispatch','dispatch') end if not c.limb_ready then return nil,'unverified_limb_feed' end if c.blackout_attempted then if not c.blackout_burst_done and has(c,'blackout') and has(c,'paralysis') and c.form=='rain' then return combo(c,{'frontkick left','kuro left','ruku right'},'blackout_burst') end return lock(c) end if not has(c,'paralysis') or not has(c,'clumsiness') then if c.form~='oak' then return travel(c,'oak','blackout_hindrance') end return combo(c,{'nervestrike light','ruku light left','risingkick torso'},'blackout_hindrance') end if c.form~='rain' then return travel(c,'rain','blackout_prep') end for _,name in ipairs{'leftarm','rightarm','leftleg'} do if (limb(c,name) or 0)>=100 or has(c,name) then return nil,'awaiting_limb_recovery' end end local hit=Yso.ref.monk.shikudo.kuro.limb_damage.pct local ready=true for _,name in ipairs{'leftarm','rightarm','leftleg'} do if not prepped(c,name,hit) then ready=false end end if not ready or (tonumber(c.kata) or 0)<9 then local left=not prepped(c,'leftarm',hit) and 'ruku left' or 'ruku light left' local right=not prepped(c,'rightarm',hit) and 'ruku right' or 'ruku light right' local kick=not prepped(c,'leftleg',hit) and 'kuro left' or 'kuro light left' -- All three are staff strikes: select two and keep balance legality. if prepped(c,'leftarm',hit) and prepped(c,'rightarm',hit) then return combo(c,{kick,'ruku light torso'},'blackout_prep') end return combo(c,{left,right},'blackout_prep') end if has(c,'blackout') then return combo(c,{'frontkick left','kuro left','ruku right'},'blackout_burst') end if not c.blackout_physical_ready then return nil,'awaiting_blackout_timing' end return action('mind blackout','eq','mental','blackout_start') end function S.lock_requirements(c) local leg=c.selected_leg=='rightleg' and 'rightleg' or 'leftleg' local out={ready=true,missing={},prepared={},leg=leg} for _,name in ipairs{'leftarm','rightarm',leg} do local key=name==leg and 'kuro' or 'ruku' local side=name:find('right',1,true) and 'right' or 'left' local hit=hit_info(c,key..' '..side) local known=limb_known(c,name) local n=limb(c,name) local ready=has(c,name) or (known and hit.amount and n<100 and n+hit.amount>=100-0.000000001) out.prepared[name]=ready==true if not ready then out.ready=false local reason=not known and ((c.limb_confidence or {})[name] or 'unknown')..' baseline' or (n>=100 and 'injury unconfirmed' or 'needs preparation') out.missing[#out.missing+1]=name..': '..reason end end return out end local function venom_lock(c) for _,name in ipairs{'anorexia','asthma','slickness','paralysis'} do if not has(c,name) then return false end end return true end local function core_lock(c) return venom_lock(c) and has(c,'impatience') end function S.lock_level(c) if core_lock(c) then return has(c,'weariness') and 'truelock' or 'hardlock' end if venom_lock(c) then return 'venomlock' end if has(c,'anorexia') and has(c,'asthma') and has(c,'slickness') then return 'softlock' end return 'building' end function S.select_lock_mental(c) local stage=(c.lock_plan or {}).stage if c.mode=='lock' and (stage=='harden' or stage=='maintain') and not c.mental_blocked and c.locked and c.hyperfocus=='head' and venom_lock(c) and not has(c,'impatience') then return action('mind impatience '..c.target,'eq','mental','harden_lock') end end local function staged_lock(c) local req=S.lock_requirements(c) local plan=c.lock_plan or {};local stage=plan.stage or 'prepare' if stage=='pressure' and not req.ready then stage='prepare' end if stage=='close_leg' and not (has(c,'leftarm') and has(c,'rightarm')) then stage='prepare' end if stage=='close_anorexia' and not (has(c,'leftarm') and has(c,'rightarm') and has(c,req.leg) and has(c,'prone')) then stage='prepare' end if stage=='maintain' and not core_lock(c) then stage='harden' end if (stage=='harden' or stage=='maintain') and not venom_lock(c) then stage='prepare' end if stage=='harden' and core_lock(c) then stage='maintain' end local function decorate(a,why) if a then a.lock_stage=stage;a.requirements=req end return a,why end local function make(attacks,phase,nextplan,intent,destination) local a,why=combo(c,attacks,phase,intent,destination) if a then a.next_lock_plan=nextplan end return decorate(a,why) end local function filler() local out={} for i,piece in ipairs(fillers[c.form] or {}) do out[i]=req.leg=='rightleg' and piece=='kuro light left' and 'kuro light right' or piece end return out end local function go(destination,nextplan) local hop=next_form(c.form,destination) if not hop then return nil,'no_legal_transition' end if (tonumber(c.kata) or 0)>=5 then return make(filler(),'lock_'..stage..'_travel',hop==destination and nextplan or {stage=stage,pressure_step=1},nil,hop) end return make(filler(),'lock_'..stage..'_kata',{stage=stage,pressure_step=1}) end if not c.form or c.form=='none' then return decorate(action('adopt rain form','bal','adopt','opening')) end if not graph[c.form] then return nil,'unknown_form' end if c.hyperfocus~='head' then return decorate(action('hyperfocus head','bal','hyperfocus','head_parry_bypass')) end if c.shield then return make({'shatter',filler()[1]},'shield') end local kata=tonumber(c.kata) or 0 if stage=='prepare' then if c.form~='rain' then return go('rain',{stage='prepare'}) end if req.ready then return go('oak',{stage='pressure',pressure_step=1}) end if kata>=21 then return go('oak',{stage='prepare'}) end if not req.prepared.leftarm or not req.prepared.rightarm then return make({'ruku left','ruku right'},'prepare_arms',{stage='prepare'}) end return make({'kuro '..(req.leg=='rightleg' and 'right' or 'left'),'ruku light torso'},'prepare_leg',{stage='prepare'}) elseif stage=='pressure' then if c.form~='oak' then return go('oak',{stage='pressure',pressure_step=1}) end local step=tonumber(plan.pressure_step) or 1 if step>=4 and kata>=5 then return make({'ruku left','ruku right'},'release_arms',{stage='close_leg'}, {leftarm='break',rightarm='break'},'willow') end if kata>=9 then return go('willow',{stage='prepare'}) end if step>=4 then step=1 end local rotation={{'nervestrike light','livestrike light'}, {'livestrike light','ruku light torso'},{'nervestrike light','ruku light torso'}} return make(rotation[step],'oak_pressure_'..step,{stage='pressure',pressure_step=step+1}) elseif stage=='close_leg' then if c.form~='willow' then return go('willow',{stage='close_leg'}) end if has(c,req.leg) and has(c,'prone') then return make({'hiraku light','hiru light'},'close_anorexia',{stage='harden'}) end if not req.prepared[req.leg] then return go('rain',{stage='prepare'}) end return make({'sweep','flashheel '..(req.leg=='rightleg' and 'right' or 'left')},'release_leg', {stage='close_anorexia'},{[req.leg]='break'}) elseif stage=='close_anorexia' then if c.form~='willow' then return go('willow',{stage='close_anorexia'}) end return make({'hiraku light','hiru light'},'close_anorexia',{stage='harden'}) elseif stage=='harden' or stage=='maintain' then -- No form detour: consume the actual closing window in the current form. local mental=S.select_lock_mental(c) if mental then return decorate(mental) end if kata>=(c.form=='rain' and 21 or 9) then return go(({rain='oak',oak='willow',willow='rain'})[c.form] or 'rain',{stage=stage}) end return make(filler(),stage=='harden' and 'harden_pressure' or 'maintain_lock',{stage=stage}) end return nil,'unknown_lock_stage' end function S.select(c) if type(c)~='table' or not tostring(c.target or ''):match("^[%a%d_'-]+$") then return nil,'invalid_target' end if c.tracked==false then return nil,'untracked_target' end if c.mode=='lock' then return staged_lock(c) end if not c.locked then return action('mind lock '..c.target,'eq','mindlock','mindlock') end if not c.form or c.form=='none' then return action('adopt '..(c.mode=='lock' and 'willow' or 'rain')..' form','bal','adopt','opening') end if not graph[c.form] then return nil,'unknown_form' end if c.shield then return combo(c,{'shatter',fillers[c.form][1]},'shield') end if c.mode=='lock' and c.hyperfocus~='head' then return action('hyperfocus head','bal','hyperfocus','head_parry_bypass') end if c.mode=='scythe' and scythe_ready(c) then return action('mind scythe','eq','mental','scythe') end if c.mode~='lock' and dispatch_ready(c) then return action('dispatch '..c.target,'bal','dispatch','dispatch') end -- Keep the conservative existing 24/12 kata ceilings; never claim measured caps. if (tonumber(c.kata) or 0)>=(c.form=='rain' and 21 or 9) and c.form~='tykonos' then return travel(c,graph[c.form][1],'kata_recovery') end if c.mode=='lock' then if c.form=='gaital' and has(c,'anorexia') and has(c,'paralysis') and has(c,'asthma') and has(c,'slickness') and has(c,'impatience') and has(c,'weariness') and not has(c,'addiction') then return combo(c,{'jinzuku light','ruku light torso'},'addiction') end return lock(c) end if c.mode=='dispatch' then return limb_route(c,false) end if c.mode=='scythe' then return limb_route(c,true) end if c.mode=='blackout' then return blackout(c) end return nil,'unknown_strategy' end return S

Script.name: Shikudo duel controller
Script.script: -- Permanent package script. Alias only controls the shared route-loop scheduler. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.off = Yso.off or {} Yso.off.monk = Yso.off.monk or {} local M = Yso.off.monk.duel or {} Yso.off.monk.duel = M M.key='monk_shikudo_duel' M.name='Shikudo duel' M.alias_owned=true M.cfg=M.cfg or {strategy='dispatch',loop_delay=0.15,confirmation_timeout=10,hit_damage={},lock_leg='left'} M.state=M.state or {} local modes={dispatch=true,lock=true,blackout=true,scythe=true} local aff_names={'anorexia','asthma','slickness','paralysis','impatience','weariness', 'leftarm','rightarm','leftleg','rightleg','head','damagedhead','mangledhead', 'crushedthroat','prone','addiction','clumsiness','healthleech','lethargy', 'stuttering','stupidity','epilepsy','dizziness','confusion','blackout'} local function now() local n=type(getEpoch)=='function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() return n>20000000000 and n/1000 or n end local function who() local n=type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or rawget(_G,'target') return tostring(n or ''):gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') end local function echo(text) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cyan>[SHDUEL]<reset> '..text..'\n') end end local function vitals() return gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} end local function up(value) return value==true or tostring(value)=='1' end local function lane_ready(lane) local v=vitals(); local n=v[lane] if n==nil then n=v[lane=='eq' and 'equilibrium' or 'balance'] end if not up(n) then return false end for _,obj in ipairs{Yso.state or {},Yso.locks or {}} do local f=obj[lane..'_ready']; if type(f)=='function' and f()~=true then return false end end return true end local function monk() local s=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status or {} local c=Yso.classinfo and type(Yso.classinfo.get)=='function' and Yso.classinfo.get() or s.class or s.classname or Yso.class return tostring(c or ''):lower()=='monk' end local function stop(reason) if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,reason,false) end end function M.init() M.state.loop_delay=tonumber(M.cfg.loop_delay) or 0.15 M.state.template=M.state.template or {} local old=M.state.pending or M.state.cooldown if M.cfg.strategy=='lock' and old and old.kind=='mindlock' then -- Migrate pre-staged package state: a free lock request owns no EQ/BAL debt. M.state.mindlock_request=M.state.mindlock_request or {target=old.target,at=old.at} M.state.pending=nil;M.state.cooldown=nil end if not M.state.room_initialized then M.note_room_players(false);M.state.room_initialized=true end return true end function M.is_enabled() return M.state.enabled==true end function M.is_active() return M.is_enabled() and monk() and Yso.mode and Yso.mode.is_combat() end function M.note_room_players(live) local players=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players if type(players)~='table' then return end M.state.room_players={};M.state.room_deltas={};M.state.room_snapshot_invalid=false if live~=false then M.state.room_live=true end for _,entry in pairs(players) do local name=type(entry)=='table' and ['yso.target.aff.gained']=function(_,name,aff) M.note_aff(name,aff) end} for event,fn in pairs(events) do if M.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.handlers[event]) end M.handlers[event]=registerAnonymousEventHandler(event,fn) end end M.init() return M
