Script.name: Dragon support
Script.script: -- Shared Yso targeting only. Readiness is local to Dragon, never truthy strings. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.dragon = Yso.dragon or {} local D=Yso.dragon D.state=D.state or {breath=false,purge=false,curse=false} function D.active() local g=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Skills and gmcp.Char.Skills.Groups or {} for k,v in pairs(g) do local name=type(v)=='table' and v.name or v if tostring(name):lower()=='dragoncraft' or tostring(k):lower()=='dragoncraft' then return true end end return false end function D.target() local t=type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if type(t)~='string' or t=='' or (type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t)) then return nil end return t end function D.emit(command,lane,kind) if not D.active() then return false end local payload=type(command)=='table' and command or {[lane or 'eq']=command} for _,key in ipairs({'eq','bal'}) do if payload[key] and payload[key]~='' then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[key] if key=='bal' and value==nil then value=v.balance end if key=='eq' and value==nil then value=v.equilibrium end -- Explicit GMCP balance loss overrides even a stale shared ready helper. if key=='bal' and (value==false or tostring(value)=='0') then return false end local ready=Yso.locks and Yso.locks[key..'_ready'] or Yso.state and Yso.state[key..'_ready'] if type(ready)=='function' then local ok,result=pcall(ready) if not ok or result~=true then return false end else if value~=true and tostring(value)~='1' then return false end end end end return Yso.emit(payload,{kind=kind or 'offense',reason='dragon:manual',commit=true,allow_eqbal=true}) end function D.manual(skill,arg) if not D.active() then return false end local t=D.target() if skill=='glide' then local a,b=tostring(arg or ''):match('^(%w+) (%w+)$') return a and D.emit('glide '..a..' '..b,'bal','utility') or false elseif skill=='leap' then local aff=Legacy and Legacy.Curing and Legacy.Curing.Affs or {} if aff.paralysis or aff.prone or not tostring(arg or ''):match('^%w+$') then return false end return D.emit('leap '..arg,'bal','utility') elseif skill=='breathstorm' then return D.state.breath and D.emit('breathstorm') or false elseif skill=='tailsweep' then return D.emit('tailsweep','bal') end if not t then return false end if skill=='blast' then return D.state.breath and D.emit('blast '..t) or false elseif skill=='breathstream' then if not D.state.breath or not tostring(arg or ''):match('^%w+$') then return false end return D.emit('breathstream '..t..' '..arg) elseif skill=='roar' then return D.emit('dragonroar '..t) elseif skill=='rend_left' then return D.emit('rend '..t..' left arm curare','bal') elseif skill=='attack' then local a=dragon_att:new(); a:curse('sensitivity',1); a:act('rend'); return a:commit() elseif skill=='key' then if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then if D.state.breath then return D.emit('blast '..t) end return D.emit('tailsmash '..t,'bal') end if affstrack and affstrack.score and (tonumber(affstrack.score.prone) or 0)>=100 then return D.emit('bite '..t,'bal') end end return false end return D

Script.name: Dragon functions
Script.script:
local unpack = unpack or table.unpack
dragon_att = {} dragon_att.__index = dragon_att dragon_att.settings = {} --bal_move --eq_move --eq_special --no_bal = {} dragon_att.settings.stand = false dragon_att.settings.lightpipes = false dragon_att.settings.pipes = {} -- target dragon_att.settings.target_limb = "nothing" -- dir -- bal_list = {} -- bal_str dragon_att.settings.sep = Yso.sep or "&&" --dragon_att.settings.my_spear = my_spear or "spear" --sent_att.settings.my_axe = my_axe or "handaxe" dragon_att.refs = {}
dragon_att.refs.bal_moves = { gut = true, rend = true, trample = true, tailsweep = true, becalm = true, demolition = true, tailsmash = true, fly = true, block = true, tumble = true, }
dragon_att.refs.eq_moves = { heal = true, enmesh = true, blast = true, curse_rand = true, breathstorm = true, strip = true, roar = true, incantation = true, }
dragon_att.refs.bal_moves_sp = { dragonflex = true, }
dragon_att.refs.eq_moves_sp = { dragonsense = true, gust = true, illusion = true, veilglance = true, veildeliver = true, contemplate = true, }
dragon_att.refs.validcurses = { paralysis = true, impatience = true, weariness = true, asthma = true, stupidity = true, recklessness = true, sensitivity = true, }
function dragon_att:new() local new_att = {} setmetatable(new_att,self) new_att.settings = {} setmetatable(new_att.settings, {__index = self.settings}) new_att.settings.no_bal = {} return new_att end
function dragon_att:gut(venom) if venom then self.bal_str = string.format("gut %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), venom) else self.bal_str = string.format("gut %s", Yso.dragon.target()) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:rend(venom, limb) local venom = venom or "curare" if not limb then self.bal_str = string.format("rend %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), venom) else self.bal_str = string.format("rend %s %s %s", Yso.dragon.target(), limb, venom) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:trample() self.bal_str = "trample" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:becalm(target) if not target then self.bal_str = "becalm" else self.bal_str = string.format("becalm %s", target) end return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:demolition(dir) self.bal_str = string.format("demolish wall %s", dir) return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:tailsweep() self.bal_str = "tailsweep" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:tailsmash() self.bal_str = string.format("tailsmash %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:heal() self.eq_str = "dragonheal" return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:enmesh() self.eq_str = string.format("enmesh %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:blast() self.eq_str = string.format("blast %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:curse(what, wait) if self.refs.validcurses[what] and tonumber(wait) then self.settings.curse = {what=what, wait=tonumber(wait)} end end
function dragon_att:curse_rand() self.eq_str = string.format("dragoncurse %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:breathstorm() self.eq_str = "breathstorm" return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:strip() self.eq_str = string.format("breathstrip %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:roar() self.eq_str = string.format("dragonroar %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:incantation() self.eq_str = string.format("incantation %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:dragonflex() self.bal_str = "dragonflex" return self.bal_str end
function dragon_att:dragonsense() self.eq_str = string.format("dragonsense %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:gust() self.eq_str = string.format("breathgust %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:illusion(line, lethal, target) local conjure if not target then conjure = "conjure illusion" else conjure = string.format("conjure %s illusion", target) end
if lethal then conjure = conjure.." lethal" end
self.eq_str = string.format("%s %s", conjure, line) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:veilglance() self.eq_str = string.format("veilglance %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:veildeliver(stuff, target) self.eq_str = string.format("veildeliver %s to %s", stuff, target) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:contemplate() self.eq_str = string.format("contemplate %s", Yso.dragon.target()) return self.eq_str end
function dragon_att:parry(limb) if type(limb) ~= "string" then error("dragon_att:parry needs a limb specified") return end self.to_parry = limb end
function dragon_att:act(move, args) if self.refs.bal_moves[move] then self.bal_move = move self.bal_args = args self.eq_move = false elseif self.refs.eq_moves[move] then self.bal_move = false self.eq_move = move self.eq_args = args self.eq_special = false elseif self.refs.eq_moves_sp[move] then self.eq_move = false self.eq_special = move self.eq_special_args = args elseif self.refs.bal_moves_sp[move] then self.bal_move = false self.bal_special = move self.bal_special_args = args end end
function dragon_att:no_bal(move) table.insert(self.settings.no_bal, move) end
function dragon_att:stand(negate, args) if not negate then self.settings.stand = true else self.settings.stand = false end end
function dragon_att:setpipes(pipelist) if type(pipelist) ~= "table" or #pipelist == 0 then error("pipe list needs to be an array of pipe ids") return end self.settings.pipes = pipelist return self.settings.pipes end
function dragon_att:lightpipes(negate) if not negate then self.settings.lightpipes = true else self.settings.lightpipes = false end end
function dragon_att:summon(btype) if type(btype) ~= "string" then error("breath type needs to be a string") return end
self.settings.summon = btype end
function dragon_att:commit() if not Yso.dragon.active() or not Yso.dragon.target() then return false end local do_first = {}
if self.settings.stand then table.insert(do_first, "stand") end
if self.settings.summon then table.insert(do_first, string.format("summon %s", self.settings.summon)) end if self.settings.lightpipes and #self.settings.pipes > 0 then for _,v in ipairs(self.settings.pipes) do table.insert(do_first, string.format("light %s", v)) end end if self.to_parry then table.insert(do_first, string.format("clawparry %s", self.to_parry)) end local actions = {} local actions_free = {} local balance_actions, eq_actions = {}, {} if #do_first > 0 then table.insert(actions_free, table.concat(do_first,self.settings.sep)) end if #self.settings.no_bal > 0 then table.insert(actions_free, table.concat(self.settings.no_bal, self.settings.sep)) end if self.settings.curse then table.insert(actions_free, string.format("dragoncurse %s %s %d", Yso.dragon.target(), self.settings.curse.what, self.settings.curse.wait)) end
-- cecho("<red:green>stopped") if self.bal_move then if self.bal_args then table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_move](self, unpack(self.bal_args))) else -- print(self[self.bal_move](self)) table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_move](self)) end end
if self.eq_move then if self.eq_args then table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_move](self, unpack(self.eq_args))) else table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_move](self)) end end if self.eq_special then if self.eq_special_args then table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_special](self,unpack(self.eq_special_args))) else table.insert(eq_actions, self[self.eq_special](self)) end end if self.bal_special then if self.bal_special_args then table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_special](self, unpack(self.bal_special_args))) else table.insert(balance_actions, self[self.bal_special](self)) end end local payload = {} for key, list in pairs({free=actions_free, eq=eq_actions, bal=balance_actions}) do if #list>0 then payload[key]=table.concat(list,Yso.sep or "&&") end end for _,key in ipairs({"free","eq","bal"}) do if payload[key] then table.insert(actions,payload[key]) end end local attack_str = table.concat(actions, Yso.sep or "&&") if attack_str == "" then return end if not Yso.dragon.emit(payload) then return false end --display(actions) return table.concat(actions, self.settings.sep) end

Airlord skillchart
Script.script: -- In-game AB Duress screenshots supplied 2026-10-11/12. Unknown timings stay nil. -- Reference data only: afflictions lists contain direct applications, not prerequisites. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.ref = Yso.ref or {} local R = {meta={class='Airlord',skillset='Duress',updated='2026-10-12',source='User supplied AB screenshots'},skills={}} Yso.ref.airlord = R local function skill(name,syntax,targets,afflictions,details) local row=details or {} row.syntax=syntax; row.targets=targets; row.afflictions=afflictions or {} R.skills[name]=row end skill('buffet','MANIFEST BUFFET <target>','adventurers and denizens',{}, { damage=true,damage_scales_with={'pressure','disloyalty','tension','manaleech','deadening'}, notes='Successive uses against the same target relapse for additional damage after two seconds.',relapse_s=2}) skill('gale','MANIFEST GALE <target>','adventurers and denizens',{}, { removes={'shield'},conditional_afflictions={{affliction='manaleech',when='Successful shield removal against an adventurer'}}}) skill('tempest','MANIFEST TEMPEST','self',{}, {defense='Damage mitigation'}) skill('tornado','MANIFEST TORNADO','adventurers and room',{}, { notes='Hinders departure by flying characters, including allies; fellow Air Elemental Lords are exempt.'}) skill('whisper','AERO WHISPER <target>','adventurers',{}, { effect='Locate an individual and report their area and room if they can be found'}) skill('glide','GLIDE <direction> [distance]','self',{}, { requires_flying=true,min_distance=1,max_distance=11,wilderness_max_distance=5, movement='Travel multiple rooms on air currents in a given direction; distance is optional'}) skill('scour','AERO SCOUR <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'disloyalty'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, relapse={absent='Reapply disloyalty and end periodic ticks',present='Stun and brief balance loss; ticks continue',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='cutting',relapse_s=2}}) skill('drift','AERO DRIFT','self',{}, {movement='Ascend into the sky'}) skill('zephyr','MANIFEST ZEPHYR <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'manaleech'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, conditional_afflictions={{affliction='deadening',when='Relapse while manaleech remains and deadening is absent'}}, relapse={absent='Reapply manaleech and end periodic ticks',present='Apply deadening; short mental blackout if both afflictions remain',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='cold',relapse_s=2}}) skill('gust','GUST <direction>','self',{}, {movement='Pass walls and similar barriers',notes='Both origin and destination must be outdoors.'}) skill('soar','AERO SOAR <LOW|HIGH|STRATOSPHERE>','self',{}, {movement='Travel to cloud locations at the chosen elevation'}) skill('asphyxiate','AERO ASPHYXIATE <target>','adventurers',{}, {effect='Reveal the type of smoke inhaled by the target'}) skill('strangle','AERO STRANGLE <target>','adventurers and denizens',{'deadening'}, { damage=true,adventurer_afflictions=true, conditional_afflictions={{affliction='disrupted',when='Relapse while deadening remains; AK tracking key'}}, relapse={absent='Reapply deadening and end periodic ticks',present='Disrupt the target; ticks continue',pressure_accelerated=true}, denizen={damage_type='asphyxiation',relapse_s=2}}) skill('lightning','MANIFEST LIGHTNING <target>','adventurers',{}, { movement='Reach a flying target above you, or travel to an outdoor target on the same continent while flying', notes='Ground-to-sky use costs no balance. Long-distance use lands you at the destination and costs a short balance. Both have a short reuse delay.'}) skill('updraft','MANIFEST UPDRAFT <target>','adventurers',{}, { damage=true,checks_afflictions={'tension'}, notes='Outdoor ground target: launch into sky. Indoor ground target: ceiling impact and damage. Flying target: force upward and damage. Recovery twice as fast with tension. Death bypasses starburst and leaves no corpse.'}) skill('tropostheria',nil,'adventurers',{}, {passive=true, effect='Attack flying targets from the ground; holding breath no longer defends against your air mastery'}) skill('silence','AERO SILENCE <target>','adventurers',{}, {effect='Prevents conventional hearing and communication'}) skill('tailwind','MANIFEST TAILWIND <target>','adventurers',{}, {duration_s=30, effect='Pursue the first successful movement by the target; consumed on pursuit'}) skill('effervescence','MANIFEST EFFERVESCENCE','adventurers and room',{}, { effect='Lingering vapour periodically robs foes of breath; holding breath is only a partial defense'}) skill('pressure','AERO PRESSURE <target>','adventurers',{}, { state_effects={'pressure'},boost_afflictions={'manaleech','disloyalty','deadening'},max_boost_afflictions=2, notes='Builds pressure, with increased gain from up to two listed afflictions. Delays movement; at least two elevations prevent many leaping abilities. Exact gain formula not specified in supplied AB.'}) skill('gauge','GAUGE <target>','adventurers',{}, {balance_cost=0,equilibrium_cost=0,reuse_approx_s=1, effect='Report current pressure elevation'}) skill('tension','AERO TENSION <target>','adventurers',{'tension'}, { state_effects={'pressure'},pressure_gain=1,effect='Prevents landing while flying; external sources can still ground the target'}) skill('skyhammer','MANIFEST SKYHAMMER','adventurers and room',{}, {damage='extreme',room_cooldown_s=60, notes='Windup blocks other actions; damages flying characters and casts them to the ground.'}) skill('compression','AERO COMPRESSION <target>','adventurers',{}, {execute=true,requires_pressure=6}) skill('stormfront','MANIFEST STORMFRONT','adventurers and room',{}, {duration_s=60,cooldown_s=300, effect='Prevents non-adjacent long-distance travel into the room'}) skill('mistral','MANIFEST MISTRAL; RUSH <direction>','self',{}, { effect='Temporary immune wind form with restricted actions', notes='Transformation has a short windup unless already flying. Channeled RUSH bypasses closed but not locked doors. Exact duration unspecified.'}) -- Balance consumption verified in the supplied spar and follow-up screenshots. for _,name in ipairs({'asphyxiate','strangle','zephyr','scour','pressure','compression','tension','updraft'}) do R.skills[name].lane='bal' end R.skills.gauge.lane='free' return R

Script.name: Compression logic
Script.script: -- Gauge observations belong to Yso's current target; no separate target selector. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off = Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord = Yso.off.airlord or {} local C = {}; Yso.off.airlord.compression = C C.state = {} C.fresh_s = 3 local function now() return Yso.util.now() end local function current(who) local t=type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' return type(who)=='string' and type(t)=='string' and t~='' and who:lower()==t:lower() end function C.clear() C.state={} end function C.observe(who,level) level=tonumber(level) if not current(who) or not level or level<0 then return false end C.state={who=who,level=level,at=now()} for _,route in pairs({Yso.off.airlord.lock,Yso.off.airlord.damage}) do if level<6 then route.release_execute() end route.sync_updraft() route.sync_buffet() end C.wake(); return true end local gauge_levels={ ['at normal levels']=0, ['slightly elevated']=1, ['elevated']=2, ['moderately elevated']=3, ['severely elevated']=4, ['extremely elevated']=5, ['terminally elevated']=6, } function C.observe_description(who,description) local level=gauge_levels[description] if level==nil then return false end return C.observe(who,level) end function C.invalidate(who) if not current(who) then return false end C.clear() for _,route in pairs({Yso.off.airlord.lock,Yso.off.airlord.damage}) do route.release_execute() route.sync_updraft() route.sync_buffet() end C.wake(); return true end function C.level() local s=C.state if current(s.who) and now()-s.at<=C.fresh_s then return s.level end end function C.ready() return (C.level() or 0)>=6 end function C.wake() if Yso.mode and type(Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop)=='function' then Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop('airlord_lock','pressure_observation') Yso.mode.nudge_route_loop('airlord_damage','pressure_observation') end end return C

Script.name: Airlord attack logic
Script.script: -- Airlord pressure/Compression offense, driven by Yso's alias route scheduler. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off = Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord = Yso.off.airlord or {} local A=Yso.off.airlord local function make_route(slot,key,name) local M = A[slot] or {}; A[slot]=M M.key=key; M.name=name; M.alias_owned=true M.cfg=M.cfg or {loop_delay=0.15,pending_s=2.5,gauge_s=1.05} M.state=M.state or {enabled=false,loop_enabled=false} M.compression=Yso.off.airlord.compression local function now() return Yso.util.now() end local function target() return type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' end local function lane_ready(lane) local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[lane] if lane=='eq' and value==nil then value=v.equilibrium end if lane=='bal' and value==nil then value=v.balance end -- Package balance helpers may be optimistic when no state helper is loaded. -- A confirmed GMCP spend must still block a balance attack. if value==false or tostring(value)=='0' then return false end local locks=Yso.locks if locks and type(locks[lane..'_ready'])=='function' then return locks[lane..'_ready']()==true end local state=Yso.state if state and type(state[lane..'_ready'])=='function' then return state[lane..'_ready']()==true end return value==true or tostring(value)=='1' end local function score(aff) local s=affstrack and affstrack.score return tonumber(s and s[aff]) or 0 end local function echo(text) if Yso.util and Yso.util.echo then Yso.util.echo(text) elseif type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<cyan>[Yso] '..text..'<reset>\n') end end function M.init() return true end function M.is_airlord() local info=Yso.classinfo local cls if info and type(info.get)=='function' then local ok,value=pcall(info.get) if ok and type(value)=='string' and value~='' then cls=value end end local status=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status or {} cls=cls or status.class or status.classname or Yso.class or '' cls=tostring(cls):lower():gsub('^%s+',''):gsub('%s+$','') return cls=='air elemental lord' or cls=='air elemental lady' or cls=='air elemental fae' end function M.is_active() return Yso.mode and Yso.mode.route_loop_active and Yso.mode.route_loop_active(M.key) or M.state.loop_enabled==true end local function clear_staged(cmd) local q=Yso.queue if not q or not cmd or type(q.list)~='function' or type(q.clear)~='function' or q.list('bal')~=cmd then return end if type(q.get_staged_owner)=='function' then local owner=q.get_staged_owner('bal') if owner and owner.route==M.key and owner.cmd==cmd then q.clear('bal') end else local hint=q._commit_hint if not hint or hint.route==M.key then q.clear('bal') end end end -- Room.Info uses an indoors flag; outdoor rooms can have an empty details array. -- Require a complete room packet so missing GMCP never implies outdoors. function M.outdoor_room() local r=gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(r)~='table' or not tonumber(r.num) or type(r.name)~='string' or r.name=='' or type(r.details)~='table' then return nil end if r.name:lower():find('(indoors)',1,true) then return nil end for _,flag in pairs(r.details) do if tostring(flag):lower()=='indoors' then return nil end end return tostring(r.num) end function M.release_updraft() local p=M.state.pending if not p or p.category~='updraft' then return end clear_staged(p.cmd) local q=Yso.queue local owned=q and type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if owned and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==p.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end function M.sync_updraft() local room=M.outdoor_room() local context=room and target():lower()..':'..room or nil if M.state.updraft_context~=context then M.release_updraft() M.state.updraft_context=context; M.state.updraft_launched=nil end local pressure=M.compression.level() or 0 if not M.cfg.updraft_enabled or not room or pressure<4 or pressure>=6 or (ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) then M.release_updraft() end return context end function M.toggle_updraft() M.cfg.updraft_enabled=not M.cfg.updraft_enabled for _,route in ipairs({A.lock,A.damage}) do route.cfg.updraft_enabled=M.cfg.updraft_enabled route.sync_updraft() end echo('Airlord optional Updraft '..(M.cfg.updraft_enabled and 'ON.' or 'OFF.')) return M.cfg.updraft_enabled end function M.note_updraft(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end local context=M.sync_updraft() if not context then return false end M.state.updraft_launched=context M.note_success(who) return true end function M.note_landed(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end M.state.updraft_launched=nil return true end function M.reset() local q=Yso.queue if q then local pending=M.state.pending clear_staged(M.state.staged_bal or (pending and pending.cmd)) local hint=q._commit_hint if (not hint or hint.route==M.key) and type(q.list)=='function' and type(q.clear)=='function' then if q._staged and type(q._staged.free)=='table' then local keep={} for _,cmd in ipairs(q._staged.free) do local observed=tostring(M.state.observation_target or '') if cmd~='gauge '..observed and not (slot=='damage' and cmd=='assess '..observed) then keep[#keep+1]=cmd end end q._staged.free=keep end end local owned=type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if type(owned)=='table' and owned.route==M.key and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.gauge_at=nil; M.state.observation_target=nil M.state.staged_bal=nil M.state.execute_inflight=nil M.state.last_cmd=nil M.state.last_setup_cmd=nil M.state.hold_reason=nil M.state.updraft_context=nil; M.state.updraft_launched=nil M.compression.clear() end function M.on_target_swap() M.reset(); return true end M.on_target_change=M.on_target_swap M.on_target_slain=M.on_target_swap M.on_target_cleared=M.on_target_swap M.on_reset=M.on_target_swap M.on_pause=M.on_target_swap M.reset_route_state=M.reset function M.can_run() if not M.state.enabled or not M.state.loop_enabled then return false,'disabled' end if Yso.offense_paused and Yso.offense_paused() then return false,'paused' end if not M.is_airlord() then return false,'wrong_class' end local t=target() if type(t)~='string' or t=='' then return false,'no_target' end local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t) then return false,'invalid_target' end return true,t end function M.select_command(t) local context=M.sync_updraft() local d=ak and ak.duress or {} if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then return 'manifest gale '..t,'defense_break' end if M.compression.ready() then return 'aero compression '..t,'execute' end -- Weave Buffet with setup/Pressure instead of letting eligibility monopolize BAL. if slot=='damage' and M.buffet_ready() and M.state.last_cmd~='manifest buffet '..t then return 'manifest buffet '..t,'buffet' end if M.cfg.updraft_enabled and context and M.state.updraft_launched~=context and (M.compression.level() or 0)>=4 then return 'manifest updraft '..t,'updraft' end -- Tension adds pressure and another smoke cure, but is not a Pressure booster. -- Interleave after an immediately cured Tension so setup/Pressure progresses. -- Buffet must not erase the previous setup step when Tension is cured quickly. local last_setup=slot=='damage' and M.state.last_setup_cmd or M.state.last_cmd if score('tension')<100 and last_setup~='aero tension '..t then if d.asphyxiate~=true then return 'aero asphyxiate '..t,'smoke_tracking' end return 'aero tension '..t,'tension' end -- Confirmed afflictions, not fractional score sums, enable efficient pressure. local count=0 for _,a in ipairs({'deadening','manaleech','disloyalty'}) do if score(a)>=100 then count=count+1 end end -- Once pressure is established, one confirmed booster is enough to keep -- building. Ambiguous smoking must not restart a full setup cycle at level 3. if count>=2 or (count>=1 and (M.compression.level() or 0)>0) then return 'aero pressure '..t,'pressure' end if d.asphyxiate~=true then return 'aero asphyxiate '..t,'smoke_tracking' end for _,row in ipairs({{'deadening','stranglerelapse','aero strangle '}, {'manaleech','zephyrrelapse','manifest zephyr '},{'disloyalty','scourrelapse','aero scour '}}) do if score(row[1])<100 and d[row[2]]~=true then return row[3]..t,'affliction' end end return 'aero pressure '..t,'pressure' end function M.buffet_ready() if (M.compression.level() or 0)<=2 then return false end local count=0 for _,aff in ipairs({'disloyalty','tension','manaleech','deadening'}) do if score(aff)>=100 then count=count+1 end end return count>=2 end function M.sync_buffet() local p=M.state.pending if not p or p.category~='buffet' then return end if M.buffet_ready() and not (ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) and not M.compression.ready() then return end clear_staged(p.cmd) local q=Yso.queue local owned=q and type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if owned and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==p.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end function M.attack_function() local ok,t=M.can_run() if not ok then if t=='paused' or t=='wrong_class' or t=='no_target' or t=='invalid_target' then if M.state.hold_reason~=t then M.reset() echo(M.name..' holding ('..t..').') end M.state.hold_reason=t end return false,t end M.state.hold_reason=nil if M.state.observation_target and M.state.observation_target~=t then M.reset() end M.state.observation_target=t M.sync_updraft() M.sync_buffet() -- Gauge is free; this damage build's balanceless Assess shares its cadence. -- Both observations are sent together without waiting for EQ/BAL. if not M.state.gauge_at or now()-M.state.gauge_at>=M.cfg.gauge_s then local observations=slot=='damage' and {'gauge '..t,'assess '..t} or 'gauge '..t if Yso.emit({free=observations,target=t,route=M.key},{kind='offense',reason='airlord:gauge',target=t,route=M.key,commit=true,wake_lane='free',free_immediate=true}) then M.state.gauge_at=now() end end if not lane_ready('bal') then local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local actual=v.bal if actual==nil then actual=v.balance end if M.state.pending and (actual==nil or actual==false or tostring(actual)=='0') then M.state.pending.saw_down=true end if M.state.execute_inflight and (actual==false or tostring(actual)=='0') then M.state.execute_inflight.saw_down=true end return false,'bal_down' end local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then if ak and ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then M.release_execute() -- Shield feedback blocks the execute; break it next. elseif flight.saw_down then if not flight.regained_at then flight.regained_at=now() end local observation=M.compression.state if M.compression.ready() and observation.at>flight.regained_at then M.release_execute() -- BAL completed and a new Gauge still shows eligibility. else return false,'execute_waiting_gauge' end elseif now()-flight.at>=M.cfg.pending_s then -- emit() also accepts staged commands. Neither staging nor dispatch -- proves execution; an unacknowledged submission has a bounded lifetime. if M.compression.ready() and M.compression.state.at>flight.at then M.release_execute() else return false,'execute_waiting_gauge' end else return false,'execute_inflight' end end local cmd,category=M.select_command(t) local p=M.state.pending if p and p.saw_down then M.state.pending=nil; p=nil end if p and now()<p.until_at then -- A new confirmed execute or shield may supersede a setup attack once. if p.category==category or (category~='execute' and category~='defense_break') then return false,'pending' end end local payload={bal=cmd,target=t,route=M.key,category=category} local opts={kind='offense',reason='airlord:'..category,target=t,route=M.key,commit=true,wake_lane='bal',repeat_command=true} if not Yso.emit(payload,opts) then return false,'emit_failed' end local q=Yso.queue M.state.staged_bal=q and type(q.list)=='function' and q.list('bal')==cmd and cmd or nil M.state.pending={cmd=cmd,category=category,until_at=now()+M.cfg.pending_s} if category=='execute' then M.state.execute_inflight={at=now(),cmd=cmd,status='submitted'} end M.state.last_cmd=cmd if category~='buffet' then M.state.last_setup_cmd=cmd end return true,cmd end function M.release_execute() local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then local q=Yso.queue if q then clear_staged(flight.cmd) local owned=type(q.get_owned)=='function' and q.get_owned('bal') or nil if type(owned)=='table' and owned.route==M.key and owned.cmd==flight.cmd and type(q.clear_lane)=='function' then q.clear_lane('bal') end end M.state.pending=nil; M.state.staged_bal=nil end M.state.execute_inflight=nil end function M.note_execute(who) if type(who)~='string' or who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end local flight=M.state.execute_inflight if flight then flight.status='executed'; flight.saw_down=true M.note_success(who) end return true end function M.reject_pending() if not M.is_active() or not M.state.pending then return false end M.release_execute(); M.state.pending=nil return true end function M.on_send_result(payload) if type(payload)=='table' and payload.route==M.key and payload.success==false then M.release_execute(); M.state.pending=nil end end function M.note_success(who) if who and who:lower()~=target():lower() then return false end if M.state.pending then M.state.pending.acknowledged=true end return true end function M.alias_loop_on_started() M.reset(); echo(M.name..' ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) M.reset() if not ctx or not ctx.silent then echo(M.name..' OFF ('..tostring(ctx and ctx.reason or 'manual')..').') end end function M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() M.reset(); return true end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() return false end -- Match the route-loop hold behavior: transient context blocks attacks, not the toggle. M.alias_loop_stop_details={disabled=true} function M.alias_loop_on_error(err) echo('Airlord error: '..tostring(err)) end function M.on_exit() if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,'exit',true) end M.reset(); return true end if Yso.off.core and Yso.off.core.register then Yso.off.core.register(M.key,M) end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then if M.room_handler and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.room_handler) end M.room_handler=registerAnonymousEventHandler('gmcp.Room.Info',function() M.sync_updraft() end) end return M end local lock=make_route('lock','airlord_lock','Airlord lock') local damage=make_route('damage','airlord_damage','Damage route') damage.cfg.updraft_enabled=lock.cfg.updraft_enabled==true -- Feedback follows the active route; inactive state cannot acknowledge its work. function A.feedback(method,...) for _,route in ipairs({A.lock,A.damage}) do if route.is_active() and type(route[method])=='function' then route[method](...) end end end return lock

Script.name: Airlord manual
Script.script: -- Manual aliases share Yso's target and emission API; never set a class target. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.off=Yso.off or {}; Yso.off.airlord=Yso.off.airlord or {} local A=Yso.off.airlord function A.manual(skill,direction,distance) local route=A.lock if not route or not route.is_airlord() then return false end local r=Yso.ref.airlord.skills[skill] if not r or not r.syntax then return false end local cmd=r.syntax:match('^[^;]+'):lower() if skill=='glide' then if type(direction)~='string' or not direction:match('^[A-Za-z]+$') then return false end cmd='glide '..direction:lower() if distance~=nil and distance~='' then local n=tonumber(distance) if not n or n%1~=0 or n<1 or n>11 then return false end cmd=cmd..' '..tostring(n) end end local t if cmd:find('<target>',1,true) then t=Yso.get_target() local valid=Yso.target_is_valid or Yso.is_current_target if not t or t=='' or (type(valid)=='function' and not valid(t)) then return false end cmd=cmd:gsub('<target>',function() return t end) end local lane=r.lane or 'eq' -- Unobserved utility skills retain their existing lane. return Yso.emit({[lane]=cmd,target=t},{kind=skill=='mistral' and 'defense' or 'offense',reason='airlord:manual',commit=true,target=t,wake_lane=lane,free_immediate=lane=='free',repeat_command=true}) end return A

Script.name: Apostate utilities
Script.script:
-- Maintained source for the Mudlet Apostate utilities script. Yso = Yso or {}; Yso.apostate = Yso.apostate or {} local A = Yso.apostate A.trace_state = A.trace_state or { count = 0, interval = 2, party = false }
local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ''):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')) end local function note(s) if type(cecho) == 'function' then cecho('<DeepPink>[Apostate] <violet_red>' .. s .. '\n') end end local function person(s) return s:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") ~= nil end function A.active() local status = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status local class = status and (status.class or status.classname) or Yso.class return trim(class):lower() == 'apostate' end local function enabled() if A.active() then return true end note('This alias requires Apostate class.'); return false end local function current_target() local name = type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' and Yso.get_target() or nil name = trim(name) if not person(name) then note('Set a valid target first.'); return nil end return name end local function command(cmd, clear) if type(send) ~= 'function' then return false end if clear then send('cq all', false) end send(cmd, false); return true end
function A.alias(kind, arg) if not enabled() then return false end arg = trim(arg) local cmd if kind == 'beck' then if arg ~= '' and not person(arg) then note('Use beck [person].'); return false end cmd = 'demon beckon' .. (arg ~= '' and ' ' .. arg or '') elseif kind == 'melt' then if not arg:match('^[A-Za-z0-9_%-]+$') then note('Use dmelt <icewall>.'); return false end cmd = 'demon scorch ' .. arg elseif kind == 'shrivel' then arg = arg:lower():gsub('%s+', ' ') local limbs = {arms=true, legs=true, ['left arm']=true, ['right arm']=true, ['left leg']=true, ['right leg']=true} if not limbs[arg] then note('Use shriv arms|legs|left arm|right arm|left leg|right leg.'); return false end local target = current_target(); if not target then return false end cmd = 'shrivel ' .. arg .. ' ' .. target elseif kind == 'sap' or kind == 'strip' or kind == 'soulstorm' or (kind == 'blackwind' and arg == 'c') then local target = current_target(); if not target then return false end local verbs = {sap='demon sap', strip='demon strip', soulstorm='soulstorm', blackwind='choke'} cmd = verbs[kind] .. ' ' .. target else local choices = { siphon = {o='demon syphon', f='demon syphon off'}, pentagram = {c='carve pentagram', d='dispel pentagram'}, gravehands = {s='summon hands of the grave', b='banish hands of the grave'}, blackwind = {w='blackwind', h='human'}, } cmd = choices[kind] and choices[kind][arg] if not cmd then note('Invalid Apostate alias option.'); return false end end return command(cmd, true) end
function A.trace(prefix, name, interval) if not enabled() then return false end name = trim(name) if name:lower() == 'off' then return command('demon trace off', false) end interval = trim(interval) local every = interval == '' and 2 or tonumber(interval) if not person(name) or not every or every < 1 or every % 1 ~= 0 then note('Use [p]trace <person> [positive movement count], or trace off.'); return false end local s = A.trace_state s.target, s.count, s.interval, s.party = name, 0, every, prefix == 'p' command('demon trace ' .. name, false) if s.party then command('pt Tracing ' .. name .. ', reporting on ' .. every .. ' movements', false) end return true end function A.trace_started(name) local s = A.trace_state name = trim(name) if not s.target or s.target:lower() ~= name:lower() then s.party = false end s.target, s.count = name, 0 end function A.trace_moved(name, room) local s = A.trace_state if not A.active() or not s.target or trim(name):lower() ~= s.target:lower() then return end s.count = (s.count or 0) + 1 if not s.party then return end if room == 'On the clouds' then command('pt ' .. name .. " duanathar'd", false) end if s.count >= s.interval then command('pt ' .. name .. ' moved to ' .. room, false); s.count = 0 end end function A.trace_halted() local s = A.trace_state if s.party and A.active() then command('pt Tracing off', false) end s.target, s.count, s.party = nil, 0, false end function A.reset() A.baalzadeen, A.taste, A.pentagram = nil, nil, nil local s = A.trace_state s.target, s.count, s.party = nil, 0, false end
-- Only a fresh Contemplate response can request Catharsis. No delayed replay. function A.note_mana(name, current, maximum) -- Replies arrive in request order. Consume a cancelled route request before -- permitting the standalone helper to handle a later manual Contemplate. local key=type(name)=='string' and name:lower() or '' local cancelled=A.cancelled_contemplates and A.cancelled_contemplates[key] or 0 if cancelled>0 then A.cancelled_contemplates[key]=cancelled-1 return false end if not A.active() then return false end local victim = type(Yso.get_target) == 'function' and Yso.get_target() or nil if type(victim) ~= 'string' or not person(victim) or type(name) ~= 'string' or victim:lower() ~= name:lower() then return false end current, maximum = tonumber(current), tonumber(maximum) if not current or not maximum or maximum <= 0 or current < 0 or current > maximum or current ~= current or maximum ~= maximum or maximum == math.huge then return false end if Yso.tgt and type(Yso.tgt.set_mana_pct) == 'function' then Yso.tgt.set_mana_pct(victim, current * 100 / maximum) end local route = Yso.off and Yso.off.apostate and Yso.off.apostate.truelock if route and route.is_enabled() then return false end -- Lock route owns offense; no automatic Catharsis. if current * 2 >= maximum or type(sendAll) ~= 'function' then return false end local now = type(getEpoch) == 'function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() if now > 20000000000 then now = now / 1000 end if A.catharsis_sent_at and now - A.catharsis_sent_at < 4.4 then return false end A.catharsis_sent_at = now sendAll('cq all', 'demon catharsis ' .. victim) return true end
-- Replace handlers on script reload instead of registering duplicate callbacks. if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then A.handlers = A.handlers or {} local events = { ['gmcp.Room.Info'] = function() local room = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local id = room and room.num if id == nil or A.room_id ~= id then A.pentagram = nil end A.room_id = id end, ['sysDisconnectionEvent'] = function() A.reset(); A.room_id = nil; A.catharsis_sent_at = nil end, ['gmcp.Char.Status'] = function() if not A.active() then A.reset() end end, } for event, fn in pairs(events) do if A.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler) == 'function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(A.handlers[event]) end A.handlers[event] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, fn) end end

Script.name: Apostate entourage
Script.script:
-- Shared balanceless orders. Summoning and pentagram setup stay manual. Yso = Yso or {} Yso.apostate = Yso.apostate or {} local E = Yso.apostate.entourage or {} Yso.apostate.entourage = E
local function dispatch(command) local sender = Yso.send if type(sender) == 'function' then local ok, result = pcall(sender, command) return ok and result == true end if type(send) ~= 'function' then return false end local ok, result = pcall(send, command, false) return ok and result ~= false end
function E.attack(target) if type(target) ~= 'string' or not target:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") then return false, 'invalid_target' end if E.target and E.target:lower() == target:lower() then return true end
-- A sender can fail after transmitting: preserve the need for cleanup. E.needs_passive = true E.target = nil if not dispatch('order entourage kill ' .. target) then return false, 'send_failed' end E.target = target return true end
function E.passive() if not E.needs_passive then return true end E.target = nil if not dispatch('order entourage passive') then return false, 'send_failed' end E.target = nil E.needs_passive = false return true end
return E

Script.name: Apostate Truelocks
Script.script:
-- Lock decisions are separate from delivery; AK owns confirmed target state. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.off=Yso.off or {};Yso.off.apostate=Yso.off.apostate or {} local M=Yso.off.apostate.truelock or {};Yso.off.apostate.truelock=M M.key='apostate_truelock';M.alias_owned=true M.state=M.state or {};M.state.loop_delay=0.15 M.Affliction_giving={ 'paralysis','undeaf','impatience','asthma','manaleech','slickness','anorexia','disloyalty', } M.Padding_mental_afflictions={ 'stupidity','confusion','dizziness','dementia', } M.undeaf_delivery='evileye' -- Optional: 'prefarar' uses Puncture when available. local eyes={undeaf='sensitivity',slickness='sicken',stupidity='stupid',dizziness='dizzy'} local function present(value) return value==true or (tonumber(value) or 0)>=100 end local function same(a,b) return type(a)=='string' and type(b)=='string' and a:lower()==b:lower() end local function valid(name) return type(name)=='string' and name:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") end local function victim() return type(Yso.get_target)=='function' and Yso.get_target() or '' end local function now() local t=type(getEpoch)=='function' and tonumber(getEpoch()) or os.time() return t>20000000000 and t/1000 or t end
-- Conditions control eligibility; the editable lists control giving order. function M.select(scores) local opening=not present(scores.asthma) or not present(scores.impatience) local needs_manaleech=not present(scores.manaleech) local eligible={paralysis=true,undeaf=true} if opening then eligible.impatience=true;eligible.asthma=true elseif needs_manaleech then eligible.manaleech=true else eligible.slickness=true;eligible.anorexia=true end local out,seen={},{} local function add(aff) -- AK's deaf=100 means deafness has been stripped; no new score is invented. local score=aff=='undeaf' and scores.deaf or scores[aff] if #out<2 and not seen[aff] and not present(score) then out[#out+1]=aff;seen[aff]=true end end for _,aff in ipairs(M.Affliction_giving) do if eligible[aff] then add(aff) end end if not opening and needs_manaleech then for _,aff in ipairs(M.Padding_mental_afflictions) do add(aff) end end return out end function M.eye_command(name,picks,curseward) if #picks==0 then return nil end local first=eyes[picks[1]] or picks[1] if curseward then return 'deadeyes '..name..' breach '..first end if picks[2] then return 'deadeyes '..name..' '..first..' '..(eyes[picks[2]] or picks[2]) end return 'stare '..name..' '..first end
local function note(text) if type(cecho)=='function' then cecho('<DeepPink>[Truelocks] <reset>'..text..'\n') end end function M.is_enabled() return M.state.loop_enabled==true end function M.is_active() return M.is_enabled() and Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.active() and Yso.mode and Yso.mode.is_combat() end function M.stop(reason) if Yso.mode and Yso.mode.stop_route_loop then Yso.mode.stop_route_loop(M.key,reason,false) else M.state.loop_enabled=false;M.alias_loop_on_stopped({reason=reason}) end return false end function M.alias_loop_prepare_start(ctx) M.state.pending=nil;M.state.victim=nil;M.state.reason=nil M.state.commands={} M.state.bal_until=nil;M.state.eq_until=nil;M.state.startup_error=nil return ctx end function M.alias_loop_on_started() if M.state.creatures_ordered and M.state.victim then return end local name=victim() if not valid(name) then M.state.startup_error='no_target';return end if not (Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.active()) then M.state.startup_error='wrong_class';return end if not same(name,target) then M.state.startup_error='ak_target_mismatch';return end local entourage=Yso.apostate.entourage if not entourage then M.state.startup_error='entourage_unavailable';return end M.state.victim=name;M.state.creatures_ordered=true if not entourage.attack(name) then M.state.startup_error='creature_orders_failed' end note('ON.') end function M.alias_loop_on_stopped(ctx) if M.state.creatures_ordered then local entourage=Yso.apostate and Yso.apostate.entourage if entourage and entourage.passive() then M.state.creatures_ordered=nil else note('Unable to send entourage passive order.') end end -- Older profiles may still have route-owned compatibility queue entries. local Q=Yso.queue if Q and type(Q.get_owned)=='function' then for _,lane in ipairs({'bal','eq','free'}) do local command=M.state.commands and M.state.commands[lane] if command and type(Q.list)=='function' and Q.list(lane)==command and Q.clear then Q.clear(lane) end local owned=Q.get_owned(lane) if owned and owned.route==M.key then if Q.clear_lane then pcall(Q.clear_lane,lane) end end end end M.state.pending=nil;M.state.victim=nil;M.state.reason=nil if ak and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end note('OFF ('..tostring(ctx and ctx.reason or 'manual')..').') end function M.alias_loop_clear_waiting() M.state.waiting={} end function M.alias_loop_waiting_blocks() return false end function M.alias_loop_on_error() M.stop('route_error') end function M.reset_route_state(reason) if M.is_enabled() then M.stop(reason or 'external_reset') end end function M.status() return {enabled=M.is_enabled(),target=M.state.victim,reason=M.state.reason} end local function ready(lane) local v=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local value=v[lane];if value==nil then value=v[lane=='bal' and 'balance' or 'equilibrium'] end return (value==true or tostring(value)=='1') and now()>=(M.state[lane..'_until'] or 0) and not (Yso.locks and type(Yso.locks.ready)=='function' and not Yso.locks.ready(lane)) end local function hold(reason) M.state.reason=reason;return false,reason end function M.note_pressure(kind,name,delivered) local p=M.state.pending if not p or kind~=p.action or not same(name,p.target) or not same(name,victim()) then return end if kind=='puncture' and delivered~=true then return M.stop('venom_delivery_unconfirmed') end p.confirmed=true end function M.note_eye_rejected(reason,name) local p=M.state.pending if not M.is_enabled() or not p or p.action~='eyes' or not same(p.target,victim()) or (name and not same(name,p.target)) then return false end if reason=='blind' then return M.stop('eyes_blind') end if reason~='equilibrium' and reason~='balance' and reason~='curseward' then return false end if reason=='curseward' then ak.defs=ak.defs or {};ak.defs.curseward=true end p.rejected=reason;return true end function M.note_prompt() local p=M.state.pending;if not p then return end if not same(p.target,victim()) then return M.stop('target_changed') end if p.rejected or (p.confirmed and (not p.breach or (ak.defs and ak.defs.curseward==false))) then M.state.pending=nil end end function M.attack_function() if M.state.startup_error then return M.stop(M.state.startup_error) end if not M.is_active() then return hold('route_inactive') end local name=victim() if not valid(name) then return M.stop('no_target') end if M.state.victim and not same(name,M.state.victim) then return M.stop('target_changed') end if not same(name,target) then return hold('ak_target_mismatch') end if type(Yso.offense_paused)=='function' and Yso.offense_paused() then return hold('pause') end if Yso.inhibit and type(Yso.inhibit.active)=='function' and Yso.inhibit.active() then return hold('manual_suppression') end local vitals=gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} if tostring(vitals.dead or '')=='1' then return hold('dead') end M.state.victim=name local pending=M.state.pending if pending then if now()-pending.at>=10 then return M.stop('confirmation_timeout') end return hold('waiting_'..pending.action) end if not (ak and affstrack and type(affstrack.score)=='table') then return hold('tracking_unavailable') end local scores=affstrack.score local picks=M.select(scores) local lane,cmd,cost,breach='bal',nil,0,ak.defs and ak.defs.curseward local action='eyes' if #picks>0 then -- Curseward is eye shielding. Magical shield does not block Truestare eyes. if not ready('bal') then return hold('balance') end local D=Yso.apostate.daegger if picks[1]=='undeaf' and M.undeaf_delivery=='prefarar' and not (ak.defs and ak.defs.shield) and D and D.available('prefarar') then local commands=D.build_attack('puncture',name,'prefarar') if not commands then return hold('prefarar_unavailable') end cmd=table.concat(commands,Yso.sep or (Yso.cfg and Yso.cfg.cmd_sep) or '&&') action='puncture';breach=false else cmd=M.eye_command(name,picks,breach) local keys=breach and {'breach',eyes[picks[1]] or picks[1]} or picks local R=Yso.ref and Yso.ref.apostate and Yso.ref.apostate.evileye for _,key in ipairs(keys) do local ref=R and R.skills[eyes[key] or key] if not ref then return hold('unsupported_eye:'..key) end cost=cost+(ref.resource_mana or 0) end end else if not (present(scores.paralysis) and present(scores.impatience) and present(scores.asthma) and present(scores.manaleech) and present(scores.slickness) and present(scores.anorexia)) then return hold('no_eligible_eye') end local enabled=false for _,aff in ipairs(M.Affliction_giving) do if aff=='disloyalty' then enabled=true end end if not enabled or present(scores.disloyalty) then return hold('lock_complete') end if ak.defs and ak.defs.shield then return hold('shield') end lane='eq';cmd='disfigure '..name end if (lane=='eq' or action=='eyes') and not ready('eq') then return hold('equilibrium') end local mana=tonumber(vitals.mp or vitals.mana) if mana and mana<cost then return hold('mana') end local payload={target=name,route=M.key};payload[lane]=cmd -- Record before emission: a throwing sender can leave a staged queue entry. M.state.commands=M.state.commands or {};M.state.commands[lane]=cmd if action=='puncture' and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=true end if type(Yso.emit)~='function' or Yso.emit(payload,{kind='offense',route=M.key,target=name,reason=M.key,commit=true})~=true then if action=='puncture' and ak.apostate then ak.apostate.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end return hold('emit_blocked') end M.state[lane..'_until']=now()+(lane=='eq' and 3 or (action=='puncture' and 2.15 or 1.9)) if lane=='bal' then M.state.pending={target=name,at=now(),breach=breach,action=action} end M.state.reason=lane=='bal' and ('waiting_'..action) or 'disfigure' return true end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then M.handlers=M.handlers or {} local events={ ['yso.target.changed']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('target_changed') end end, ['yso.target.cleared']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('no_target') end end, ['sysDisconnectionEvent']=function() if M.is_enabled() then M.stop('disconnect') end end, ['gmcp.Char.Status']=function() if M.is_enabled() and not Yso.apostate.active() then M.stop('wrong_class') end end, } for event,fn in pairs(events) do if M.handlers[event] and type(killAnonymousEventHandler)=='function' then killAnonymousEventHandler(M.handlers[event]) end M.handlers[event]=registerAnonymousEventHandler(event,fn) end end return M

Script.name: Apostate daegger envenom
Script.script: -- Balanceless preparation, called only immediately before a venom-delivering attack. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.apostate=Yso.apostate or {} local D=Yso.apostate.daegger or {};Yso.apostate.daegger=D D.stock=D.stock or {curare=true,kalmia=true,slike=true,gecko=true,vernalius=true, aconite=true,eurypteria=true,voyria=true,selarnia=true,notechis=false,delphinium=true, xentio=true,prefarar=true,epseth=true,digitalis=false} -- The first padding release assumed Digitalis stock that was never confirmed. -- Discard that legacy assumption on reimport; preserve measured doses and later overrides. if (tonumber(D.stock_defaults_version) or 0)<1 then if D.stock.digitalis==true then D.stock.digitalis=false end D.stock_defaults_version=1 end if D.stock.digitalis==nil then D.stock.digitalis=false end local standard={xentio=true,eurypteria=true,kalmia=true,delphinium=true,digitalis=true, darkshade=true,curare=true,epteth=true,prefarar=true,monkshood=true,euphorbia=true, colocasia=true,vernalius=true,epseth=true,larkspur=true,slike=true,notechis=true, vardrax=true,aconite=true,selarnia=true,gecko=true,scytherus=true,voyria=true} local preferred={paralysis='curare',asthma='kalmia',slickness='gecko',anorexia='slike', weariness='vernalius',stupidity='aconite',recklessness='eurypteria',voyria='voyria', haemophilia='notechis',selarnia='selarnia',shyness='digitalis'} function D.venom_for(aff) local v=preferred[aff] local map=affstrack and affstrack.venoms or {} if v and map[v]==aff then return v end local keys={};for venom,outcome in pairs(map) do if standard[venom] and outcome==aff then keys[#keys+1]=venom end end table.sort(keys);return keys[1] end function D.available(venom) local n=D.stock[venom];return n==true or (tonumber(n) or 0)>0 end function D.select_venom(profile,snapshot) for _,aff in ipairs(profile or {}) do local value=(snapshot or {})[aff] if value~=true and (tonumber(value) or 0)<100 then local v=D.venom_for(aff) if v and D.available(v) then return v,aff end end end return nil,'no_available_venom' end function D.build_attack(action,victim,venom) local verb=({puncture='daegger puncture',stab='stab'})[action] if not verb or type(victim)~='string' or not victim:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") or not standard[venom] or not (affstrack and affstrack.venoms and affstrack.venoms[venom]) then return nil,'invalid_attack' end return {'wipe daegger','envenom daegger with '..venom,verb..' '..victim} end function D.note_application(venom,weapon) if type(weapon)~='string' or not weapon:lower():find('daegger',1,true) then return end if type(D.stock[venom])=='number' then D.stock[venom]=math.max(0,D.stock[venom]-1) end end function D.emit_attack(action,victim,profile,snapshot) local venom,aff=D.select_venom(profile,snapshot) if not venom then return false,aff end local cmds,why=D.build_attack(action,victim,venom);if not cmds then return false,why end if not Yso.emit then return false,'emitter_unavailable' end local A=ak and ak.apostate if A then A.pending_daegger_wipe=true end -- Keep preparation and attack in one ordered BAL batch. A separate "free" -- lane may be server-queued behind EQ in compatible queue-enabled profiles. local sep=Yso.sep or (Yso.cfg and (Yso.cfg.cmd_sep or Yso.cfg.pipe_sep)) or '&&' local ok=Yso.emit({target=victim,bal=table.concat(cmds,sep)}, {kind='offense',route='apostate_truelock',target=victim,reason='apostate_truelock',commit=true})==true if not ok and A then A.pending_daegger_wipe=nil end return ok,aff end return D

Script.name: Deadeye combo sorter
Script.script: -- Pure preparation helpers. No alias, send, timer, or route registration. Yso=Yso or {};Yso.apostate=Yso.apostate or {} local D=Yso.apostate.deadeyes or {};Yso.apostate.deadeyes=D D.priorities=D.priorities or {} local function catalog() return Yso.ref and Yso.ref.apostate and Yso.ref.apostate.evileye end local function present(value) return value==true or (tonumber(value) or 0)>=100 end function D.build(target,first,second) local R=catalog() if type(target)~='string' or not target:match("^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z'%-]*$") then return nil,'invalid_target' end for _,key in ipairs({first or '',second or ''}) do if type(key)~='string' or not R or not R.skills[key] or not R.skills[key].deadeyes_candidate then return nil,'invalid_evileye' end end return 'deadeyes '..target..' '..first..' '..second end function D.select(priorities,afflictions) local R=catalog();if not R then return nil,nil,'reference_unavailable' end local snapshot={};for k,v in pairs(afflictions or {}) do snapshot[k]=v end local selected,seen={},{} for _,entry in ipairs(priorities or D.priorities) do local key=type(entry)=='table' and entry.keyword or entry local skill=R.skills[key] if skill and skill.deadeyes_candidate and not seen[key] then seen[key]=true local aff=type(entry)=='table' and entry.affliction or skill.affliction if key=='sicken' then aff=not present(snapshot.manaleech) and 'manaleech' or (not present(snapshot.slickness) and 'slickness' or nil) end local eligible=type(entry)~='table' or not entry.eligible or entry.eligible(snapshot,skill) -- General pressure selection uses tracked afflictions, not defence breaks or unspecified damage. if eligible and aff and not present(snapshot[aff]) then selected[#selected+1]=key;snapshot[aff]=100 if #selected==2 then return selected[1],selected[2] end end end end return nil,nil,'insufficient_candidates' end return D
